title.zh: 元朝海运正式由朱清、张瑄主持

summary.zh: 元朝为缓解大都（今北京）粮食供应紧张，任命朱清、张瑄为海道运粮万户，大规模组织海上漕运。他们从刘家港（今江苏太仓）出发，经海路至直沽（今天津），再转大都。海运量从初期的数万石增至数十万石，大大降低了运输成本，促进了沿海港口城市的发展。这一举措也催生了中国历史上最早的航海世家。

statement.en: To alleviate grain supply shortages in Dadu (present-day Beijing), the Yuan court appointed Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan as maritime transport commissioners to organize large-scale sea-based grain shipping.

title.zh: 但丁开始流亡生涯并构思《神曲》

summary.zh: 佛罗伦萨政治斗争激化，但丁所属的白党在教宗与法国王室的干预下失势。1301年黑党占领佛罗伦萨，次年但丁被以贪污和反对教宗罪名判处终身流放，没收财产，否则将被火刑处死。从此但丁再未返回故乡，在流亡中他开始创作长诗《神曲》，将痛苦转化为不朽的文学杰作。

title.zh: 金门战役：佛兰德斯平民击败法国骑士

summary.zh: 佛兰德斯城市民兵（主要为布鲁日纺织工人）在科尔特赖克附近的金门战役中，利用泥泞地形和长矛阵，奇迹般地击败了法国精锐重装骑士。此战宣告了步兵战术的复兴，削弱了法国在低地国家的控制力，激发了佛兰德斯城市自治运动。

title.zh: 巴菲乌斯战役

summary.zh: 奥斯曼一世在尼科米底亚附近击败拜占庭军，这是奥斯曼势力对帝国的首次重大胜利，小亚细亚乡野自此加速失守。

statement.zh: 奥斯曼一世在尼科米底亚附近击败拜占庭军，这是奥斯曼势力对帝国的首次重大胜利，小亚细亚乡野自此加速失守。此役显示边境游牧武装已能正面击破帝国的地方军队；拜占庭的防线依赖城市与要塞，乡间控制一旦松动，税收与兵源随之外流。奥斯曼由此从袭扰者转为地区统治者。
statement.en: Osman I defeated the Byzantine army near Nicomedia.

title.zh: 法国三级会议首次召开

summary.zh: 法国国王腓力四世为征收新税以支持对佛兰德斯的战争，在巴黎圣母院召集了由教士、贵族和市民代表组成的三级会议。这是法国历史上第一次全国性等级代表会议，虽然当时权力有限，但开创了法国君主咨询社会的先例，与英国议会发展并行。

title.zh: 金帐汗国与伊儿汗国停战

summary.zh: 蒙古两大汗国因争夺高加索地区持续战争数十年。1302年，金帐汗国脱脱汗与伊儿汗国合赞汗达成停火协议，暂时划分了在阿塞拜疆的势力范围。这一和约使丝绸之路西段恢复部分商路安全，促进了东西方贸易的短暂繁荣。

title.zh: 但丁被佛罗伦萨判处终身流放

summary.zh: 佛罗伦萨的政治派别黑党（支持教皇）和白党（反对教皇干预）发生冲突，但丁属于白党。教皇卜尼法斯八世派遣法国国王的弟弟查理·德·瓦卢瓦进入佛罗伦萨支持黑党。黑党夺取政权后，以贪污公款和反对教皇的罪名判处但丁缺席流放。但丁此后终生未能返回佛罗伦萨，在流放中完成了《神曲》。

title.zh: 元朝颁行《大元通制》

summary.zh: 元成宗命大臣将历年来颁布的格例条画编纂成法典，1303年完成《大元通制》共2539条，包括制诏、条格、断例等。这是元朝继《至元新格》后第二部重要法典，虽然未能彻底推行，但为后世研究元代法律提供了核心文献。

statement.zh: 元成宗命大臣将历年来颁布的格例条画编纂成法典，1303年完成《大元通制》共2539条，包括制诏、条格、断例等。这是元朝继《至元新格》后第二部重要法典，虽然未能彻底推行，但为后世研究元代法律提供了核心文献。
statement.en:
Emperor Chengzong ordered ministers to compile the regulations issued over the years. Completed in 1303, the Da Yuan Tong Zhi contained 2,539 articles, including imperial edicts, administrative rules, and precedents. It was the second major legal code after the Zhiyuan Xinge, and though never fully implemented, remains a key source for Yuan legal history.

For Asia in 1303, “Yuan Dynasty issues the Da Yuan Tong Zhi (Great Yuan Comprehensive Institutions)” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 威廉·华莱士在伦敦被处决

title.zh: 元成宗禁止民间私藏兵器

summary.zh: 元朝政府为防范汉人、南人造反，颁布法令收缴民间兵器，规定凡私藏弩、弓箭、铠甲者以刑律论处。但在实际执行中，南方宗族和起义军仍通过各种手段藏匿武器，这一政策反而加剧了社会矛盾，为后来的红巾军起义埋下伏笔。

title.zh: 元成宗驾崩，元武宗即位引发宫廷斗争

summary.zh: 元成宗铁穆耳无嗣，1307年2月驾崩后，皇后卜鲁罕试图拥立安西王阿难答。海山（元武宗）在弟弟爱育黎拔力八达支持下，从漠北率军南下夺取汗位，囚杀卜鲁罕和阿难答。同年6月海山在上都即位，元朝因皇位继承频繁出现内讧，削弱了统治基础。

statement.zh: 元成宗铁穆耳无嗣，1307年2月驾崩后，皇后卜鲁罕试图拥立安西王阿难答。海山（元武宗）在弟弟爱育黎拔力八达支持下，从漠北率军南下夺取汗位，囚杀卜鲁罕和阿难答。同年6月海山在上都即位，元朝因皇位继承频繁出现内讧，削弱了统治基础。
statement.en:
Emperor Chengzong (Temür) died childless in February 1307. Empress Bulugan tried to install Ananda, Prince of Anxi. Khayishan (Emperor Wuzong), supported by his brother Ayurbarwada, led troops south from Mongolia, seized the throne, imprisoned Bulugan, and killed Ananda. In June, Khayishan was enthroned in Shangdu. Frequent succession conflicts weakened the Yuan's ruling foundation.

For Asia in 1307, “Emperor Chengzong dies; Emperor Wuzong ascends amid court struggle” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元武宗铸造“至大通宝”并改革币制

summary.zh: 元武宗海山为解决财政危机，下令铸造“至大通宝”铜钱，与纸币并行流通。同时大量发行“至大银钞”，但因准备不足导致通货膨胀。这一币制改革仅维持三年即废止，反映了元代财政管理的混乱。

title.zh: 教廷正式迁至阿维尼翁——“巴比伦之囚”开始

title.zh: 欧洲第一座机械钟塔在米兰建成

summary.zh: 米兰圣戈塔多教堂建造了欧洲最早的公共机械钟，由齿轮、重锤驱动，每小时报时。这一发明改变了中世纪以祈祷钟声为时间参照的习惯，推动了市民生活的精确化。此后大型钟楼成为欧洲城市的标配，促进了商业活动的规范。

title.zh: 元武宗尊孔崇儒

summary.zh: 元武宗为争取汉族士大夫支持，下诏加封孔子为“大成至圣文宣王”，修缮孔庙，提高儒生地位。同时恢复科举制度的准备工作启动。这些举措缓和了蒙汉矛盾，但并未从根本上改变四等人制的歧视政策。

title.zh: 元武宗驾崩，元仁宗继位并废除新政

summary.zh: 元武宗海山因酒色过度于1311年正月去世，年仅30岁。其弟爱育黎拔力八达（元仁宗）在太后答己支持下继位，随即废除武宗时期发行的至大银钞、铜钱，停建新都城，恢复成宗旧制。元仁宗崇儒尚文，重用汉臣，开启了一段较稳定的统治。

statement.zh: 元武宗海山因酒色过度于1311年正月去世，年仅30岁。其弟爱育黎拔力八达（元仁宗）在太后答己支持下继位，随即废除武宗时期发行的至大银钞、铜钱，停建新都城，恢复成宗旧制。元仁宗崇儒尚文，重用汉臣，开启了一段较稳定的统治。
statement.en:
Emperor Wuzong died in January 1311 at age 30, due to excessive drinking and sex. His younger brother Ayurbarwada (Emperor Renzong), supported by Empress Dowager Dagi, took the throne. He immediately cancelled the Zhida Silver Notes and copper coins, halted new capital construction, and restored the old system of Chengzong. Renzong, who revered Confucianism and employed Han Chinese officials, opened a period of relative stability.

For Asia in 1311, “Emperor Wuzong dies; Emperor Renzong succeeds and repeals the new policies” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 维埃纳会议正式解散圣殿骑士团

summary.zh: 经过数年审判和压力，维埃纳会议最终发布教宗诏书《至高之声》，正式解散圣殿骑士团。其所有财产移交给医院骑士团，成员或被监禁、或转入其他修会。圣殿骑士团这一曾显赫两百年的军事修会彻底消失，欧洲君主对宗教势力的打击达到顶峰。

statement.zh: 经过数年审判和压力，维埃纳会议最终发布教宗诏书《至高之声》，正式解散圣殿骑士团。其所有财产移交给医院骑士团，成员或被监禁、或转入其他修会。圣殿骑士团这一曾显赫两百年的军事修会彻底消失，欧洲君主对宗教势力的打击达到顶峰。
statement.en:
In 1312, after years of trials and pressure, the Council of Vienne issued the papal bull 'Vox in excelso', formally dissolving the Knights Templar. All their property was transferred to the Hospitallers; members were either imprisoned or moved to other orders. The Templars, a prominent military order for 200 years, disappeared completely. European monarchs' attacks on religious powers reached a peak.

For Europe in 1312, “Council of Vienne officially disbands the Knights Templar” is a traceable node of Religion change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 曼萨·穆萨朝圣麦加

summary.zh: 马里皇帝曼萨·穆萨倾国力赴麦加朝圣，显赫财富震惊世界。

statement.zh: 曼萨·穆萨1324年赴麦加朝圣，随行队伍带着大量黄金，沿途在开罗等地布施，导致当地金价长期下跌。

statement.en: His spending in Cairo depressed the local gold price for years.

title.zh: 日本花园艺术完成《作庭记》

summary.zh: 日本造园家梦窗疏石总结禅宗园林理念，完成《作庭记》，强调自然与精神融合。他对西芳寺庭园的设计影响了后世枯山水风格。此书成为日本园林艺术的重要理论经典。

statement.zh: 日本造园家梦窗疏石总结禅宗园林理念，完成《作庭记》，强调自然与精神融合。把禅宗观念写入造园规则，使庭园不再只是景物布置，而成为精神修行的空间；他对西芳寺庭园的设计又把这套理念落到具体作品，影响后世枯山水风格。理论文本与实作案例并置，使此书成为日本园林艺术的重要理论经典。
statement.en: The Japanese gardener Mengchuang Shushi summarized the concept of Zen gardens and completed "Zuo Ting Ji", emphasizing the integration of nature and spirit.

title.zh: 元仁宗下诏恢复科举

summary.zh: 元仁宗接受儒臣建议，下诏恢复科举，定于1314年举行乡试，1315年会试。考试采用“左右分榜”，蒙古、色目人考一榜，汉人、南人考另一榜，但名额分配严重不均。这是元朝唯一一次真正执行的科举，对汉族士大夫是重大利好。

title.zh: 班诺克本战役：苏格兰重创英格兰

summary.zh: 苏格兰国王罗伯特·布鲁斯在班诺克本沼泽地以长矛兵方阵迎战英格兰爱德华二世大军。英军骑兵在沼泽中陷入困境，被苏格兰长矛兵捅杀溃败。爱德华二世逃往邓巴，英军死伤惨重。此战使苏格兰事实上独立，罗伯特·布鲁斯巩固王位，成为民族英雄。

1314年的苏格兰，「班诺克本战役：苏格兰重创英格兰」属于军事领域。
statement.en:
King Robert the Bruce of Scotland met the huge army of England's Edward II in the marshes of Bannockburn, using pike schiltrons. The English cavalry got bogged down and were slaughtered by Scottish spearmen. Edward II fled to Dunbar, and the English suffered heavy casualties. The battle effectively secured Scottish independence and cemented Robert the Bruce as a national hero.

For Europe in 1314, “Battle of Bannockburn: Scotland crushes England” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

summary.zh: 元朝恢复科举后的第一次乡试在全国17个行省同步开考。约300名汉人、南人中选，与蒙古、色目考生一起准备次年的会试。虽然录取名额偏向蒙古色目人，但士人仍视之为光明之路。

title.zh: 法国国王路易十世释放农奴

summary.zh: 法王路易十世为了增加王室收入和讨好民众，颁布敕令释放王室领地上的农奴，允许他们花钱赎身或通过定居自由获得身份。此举虽然局限于王室领地，但推动了法国农民解放进程。

title.zh: 欧洲大饥荒爆发

summary.zh: 连绵阴雨导致欧洲大陆谷物绝收，从爱尔兰到波兰爆发大面积饥荒。1315-1317年间饿死人数高达10-25%，人相食记录频现。饥荒削弱了欧洲人口，使黑死病到来时免疫力低下。它也加剧了社会动荡和反犹浪潮。

title.zh: 元朝会试及殿试顺利完成

summary.zh: 会试中选的56人（实际包括蒙古色目32人、汉人南人24人）参加殿试，元仁宗亲自赐策问。最终录取护都答儿等56人为进士。这是元朝科举最高光时刻，此后虽有中断，但仁宗朝科举对汉族文化传承意义重大。

statement.zh: 会试中选的56人（实际包括蒙古色目32人、汉人南人24人）参加殿试，元仁宗亲自赐策问。最终录取护都答儿等56人为进士。这是元朝科举最高光时刻，此后虽有中断，但仁宗朝科举对汉族文化传承意义重大。
statement.en:
56 candidates (including 32 Mongols and Semu, and 24 Han and Southern Chinese) passed the metropolitan exam and attended the palace exam, where Emperor Renzong personally posed questions. In the end, 56 jinshi (including Khutughtu) were selected. This was the high point of the Yuan examinations. Although later interrupted, the Renzong era's examinations were crucial for transmitting Han culture.

For Asia in 1315, “Yuan metropolitan and palace examinations successfully held” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元朝恢复广东市舶司

summary.zh: 元朝重开广州、泉州、宁波市舶司，鼓励海外贸易。来自波斯、阿拉伯和东南亚的商人云集泉州港，刺桐城成为世界级大港。

statement.zh: 元朝重开广州、泉州、宁波市舶司，鼓励海外贸易。来自波斯、阿拉伯和东南亚的商人云集泉州港，刺桐城成为世界级大港。市舶司管理征税、验货与航务，海商以季风往返，瓷器、丝绸与香料构成主要货流；外来社群在城市中聚居。海洋贸易支撑了元的财政与城市繁荣。
statement.en: The Yuan Dynasty reopened Guangzhou, Quanzhou, and Ningbo shipping offices to encourage overseas trade.

statement.en:
Emperor Renzong sent envoys to make peace with Yesün Temür, leader of the Ögedei Khanate. Both sides recognised the Chagatai Khanate's sphere of influence north of the Amu Darya, and the Yuan gave up direct control of Central Asia. The Silk Road regained security, and East‑West diplomatic exchanges increased.

For Asia in 1319, “Yuan ends war with the Ögedei Khanate” is a traceable node of Diplomacy change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 波斯细密画派形成

summary.zh: 大不里士画派在蒙古伊儿汗国宫廷赞助下创作《史集》插图，融合中国工笔画风和波斯传统，开创了细密画黄金时代。此风格影响了整个伊斯兰世界。

statement.zh: 大不里士画派在蒙古伊儿汗国宫廷赞助下创作《史集》插图，融合中国工笔画风和波斯传统，开创了细密画黄金时代。此风格影响了整个伊斯兰世界。宫廷委托把历史编纂与图像叙事结合，中国式的线条与空间处理进入波斯绘画；画坊与纸张、颜料供应支撑创作。伊斯兰艺术由此丰富。
statement.en: The Tabriz School of Painting created the illustrations for the "Collection of History" under the auspices of the court of the Mongolian Ilkhanate, integrating Chinese meticulous painting style and Persian tradition, creating a golden age of miniature painting.

title.zh: 科隆大教堂唱诗台竣工祝圣

summary.zh: 1248年8月15日，科隆大主教康拉德·冯·霍赫施塔登为新的哥特式主教座堂奠基，以安放1164年自米兰迎来的"三王圣髑"。东端唱诗台自后殿起建：1265年下层告成，约1300年高侧窗与飞扶壁体系完工，其后又费二十余年安装彩窗、唱诗席与主祭坛，终于1322年9月27日由大主教海因里希二世·冯·菲尔讷堡祝圣，教堂第一期工程至此完成。唱诗台内拱高逾四十米，104个

statement.en: On 15 August 1248 Archbishop Konrad von Hochstaden laid the foundation stone of a new Gothic cathedral at Cologne to house the relics of the Three Kings, brought from Milan in 1164.

title.zh: 南坡之变：元英宗遇刺

summary.zh: 元英宗与拜住在南坡店（今内蒙古正蓝旗）被守旧派贵族铁失、也先铁木儿等人刺杀，英宗年仅21岁。他们拥立元英宗叔父也孙铁木儿（泰定帝）即位。这次政变彻底粉碎了元朝汉化改革的希望，此后元朝陷入内乱。

statement.zh: 元英宗与拜住在南坡店（今内蒙古正蓝旗）被守旧派贵族铁失、也先铁木儿等人刺杀，英宗年仅21岁。他们拥立元英宗叔父也孙铁木儿（泰定帝）即位。这次政变彻底粉碎了元朝汉化改革的希望，此后元朝陷入内乱。
statement.en:
Emperor Yingzong and Baiju were assassinated at Nanpo (present-day Zhenglan Banner, Inner Mongolia) by conservative nobles led by Tegshi and Yesün Temür. Yingzong was only 21. The conspirators enthroned Yingzong's uncle, Yesün Temür (Emperor Taiding). This coup completely crushed the Yuan's sinicisation reforms, and thereafter the Yuan fell into internal strife.

For Asia in 1323, “Nanpo Incident: Emperor Yingzong assassinated” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 挪威签订和平条约结束内战

summary.zh: 挪威国王马格努斯七世与反对派签订条约，确认王室继承法，结束了长达20年的王位争夺。挪威此后与瑞典联合，国力下降。

statement.zh:
挪威国王马格努斯七世与反对派签订条约，确认王室继承法，结束了长达20年的王位争夺。挪威此后与瑞典联合，国力下降。贵族与教会在谈判中获得确认的权利，王位继承的顺序被写入契约；联合王位使挪威的财政与防务受制于斯德哥尔摩，地方贵族由此扩大自主。

把「挪威签订和平条约结束内战」放回1323年的挪威，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: King Magnus VII of Norway signed a treaty with the opposition, confirming the royal succession law and ending a 20-year struggle for the throne.

title.zh: 马里帝国曼萨·穆萨开始史诗级麦加朝圣

summary.zh: 马里皇帝曼萨·穆萨率领约6万人（含1.2万奴隶）、80头骆驼驮黄金，从尼亚尼出发前往麦加朝圣。途经开罗时，他挥霍黄金使当地金价暴跌20%，欧洲从此将马里视为黄金之国。此次朝圣彰显了西非的富庶，1375年加泰罗尼亚地图将穆萨绘为手持金权的帝王。

summary.zh: 著名旅行家马可·波罗病逝，留下《马可·波罗游记》。临终前亲友劝他删去书中“夸大”内容，他答道：“我还没说出所见所闻的一半。”他的著作激发了欧洲人对东方的向往，间接推动大航海时代。

statement.zh: 著名旅行家马可·波罗病逝，留下《马可·波罗游记》。临终前亲友劝他删去书中“夸大”内容，他答道：“我还没说出所见所闻的一半。”他的著作激发了欧洲人对东方的向往，间接推动大航海时代。
statement.en:
The famous traveller Marco Polo died in Venice, leaving behind 'The Travels of Marco Polo'. On his deathbed, friends urged him to delete 'exaggerations' from the book; he replied, 'I have not told half of what I saw and heard.' His work inspired European curiosity about the East and indirectly spurred the Age of Discovery.

For Europe in 1324, “Marco Polo dies in Venice” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元朝禁止汉人持有弓箭

summary.zh: 元泰定二年（公元1325年），元朝下诏严厉禁止汉人、南人持有弓箭和兵器。元朝作为蒙古少数民族政权对汉人实施了严格的武器管制。但这一禁令无法阻止各地日益频繁的农民起义和走私贸易。

statement.zh: 元泰定2年（公元1325年），元朝下诏严厉禁止汉人、南人持有弓箭和兵器。元朝作为蒙古少数民族政权对汉人实施了严格的武器管制。但这一禁令无法阻止各地日益频繁的农民起义和走私贸易。
statement.en:
In 1325 (Taiding 2), the Yuan issued a strict decree forbidding Han Chinese and Southern Chinese from possessing bows, arrows, or weapons. As a Mongol minority regime, the Yuan enforced severe weapons controls over the Han. The ban, however, could not prevent increasing peasant uprisings and smuggling.

title.zh: 青花瓷成熟

summary.zh: 元代景德镇以钴料在白瓷上绘制纹样，烧成青花瓷，成为此后数百年中国瓷器的代表。

statement.zh:
元代景德镇以钴料在白瓷上绘制纹样，烧成青花瓷，成为此后数百年中国瓷器的代表。钴料发色稳定，釉下彩在高温一次烧成，使纹样清晰耐久；器形与纹饰又呼应伊斯兰市场的需求，产品远销西亚与东非。景德镇因此成为制瓷中心，青花也成为后世外销瓷的主力。

把「青花瓷成熟」放回1325年的中国，可以看到工艺变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Yuan-dynasty Jingdezhen paints cobalt-blue designs on white porcelain, perfecting blue-and-white ware that defines Chinese ceramics for centuries.

title.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰建城：阿兹特克帝国开始

summary.zh: 公元1325年，阿兹特克人（墨西卡人）在特斯科科湖中的小岛上建立了特诺奇蒂特兰（Tenochtitlan，今墨西哥城）。根据传说，他们在看到鹰站在仙人掌上叼蛇的地方建城。阿兹特克通过"三方同盟"（与德斯科科和特拉科潘结盟）建立起中美洲最强大的帝国。特诺奇蒂特兰在西班牙人到来前（1519年）拥有约20万人口，是当时世界最大的城市之一。

title.zh: 奥尔汗夺取布鲁萨，奥斯曼有了都城

summary.zh: 1326年4月6日，奥尔汗攻占拜占庭城市布鲁萨（今布尔萨）；另有来源把陷落放在1324年。布鲁萨成为奥斯曼的都城，1327年奥尔汗铸造第一批银币，并把军队改编为更稳定的常备步兵与骑兵。

statement.zh: 1326年4月6日，奥尔汗攻占拜占庭城市布鲁萨（今布尔萨）；另有来源把陷落放在1324年。奥斯曼的传统说法称他在这座城陷落后不久去世，也有学者把其死年定在1324年。
statement.en: On April 6, 1326, Orhan captured the Byzantine city of Bursa; some sources date the fall to 1324. Ottoman tradition holds that Osman died shortly after the city fell, while some scholars place his death in 1324.

sources.excerpt: Osman was succeded by his son Orhan, who captured Bursa on April 6, 1326. Ottoman tradition holds that Osman died just after the capture of Bursa, but some scholars have argued that his death should be placed in 1324, the year of Orhan's accession.

zh: 1326年4月6日，奥尔汗攻占拜占庭城市布鲁萨（今布尔萨）；另有来源把陷落放在1324年。奥斯曼的传统说法称他在这座城陷落后不久去世，也有学者把其死年定在1324年。
en: On April 6, 1326, Orhan captured the Byzantine city of Bursa; some sources date the fall to 1324. Ottoman tradition holds that Osman died shortly after the city fell, while some scholars place his death in 1324.

note.zh: 并列 1326 与 1324 两说，不把奥斯曼死亡写成确定日期。
note.en: Both 1326 and 1324 are given; Osman's death is not fixed to one date.

statement.zh: 布鲁萨成为奥尔汗的都城。它把战争收益集中到一个固定城市：宫廷、税收与宗教学校都在这里落地，奥斯曼不再只是流动的边境武装。
statement.en: Bursa became Orhan's capital. It concentrated war revenue in a fixed city: court, taxation and religious schools took root there, and the Ottomans ceased to be only a mobile frontier force.

sources.excerpt: Orhan built mosques, medreses (theological colleges), and caravansaries in the newly conquered towns, particularly the Ottoman capital, Bursa, which later became a major Islamic centre.

zh: 布鲁萨成为奥尔汗的都城。它把战争收益集中到一个固定城市：宫廷、税收与宗教学校都在这里落地，奥斯曼不再只是流动的边境武装。
en: Bursa became Orhan's capital. It concentrated war revenue in a fixed city: court, taxation and religious schools took root there, and the Ottomans ceased to be only a mobile frontier force.

note.zh: “固定城市”是作者对迁都意义的解释，不补宫廷制度细节。
note.en: The 'fixed city' point is interpretation; no extra court institutions are invented.

statement.zh: 1327年，奥尔汗以自己名义铸造第一批银币，并把军队改编为领薪的常备步兵（yaya）与骑兵（müsellem），减少对游牧袭掠者的依赖。
statement.en: In 1327 Orhan minted the first silver Ottoman coins in his own name and reorganized the army into paid regular infantry (yaya) and cavalry (müsellem), reducing dependence on nomadic raiders.

sources.excerpt: Orhan's reign also marked the beginning of the institutions that transformed the Ottoman principality into a powerful state. In 1327 the first silver Ottoman coins were minted in Orhan's name, while the Anatolian conquests were consolidated and the army was reorganized on a more permanent basis.

zh: 1327年，奥尔汗以自己名义铸造第一批银币，并把军队改编为领薪的常备步兵（yaya）与骑兵（müsellem），减少对游牧袭掠者的依赖。
en: In 1327 Orhan minted the first silver Ottoman coins in his own name and reorganized the army into paid regular infantry (yaya) and cavalry (müsellem), reducing dependence on nomadic raiders.

note.zh: “领薪”是对常备军的解释，来源只说军队更永久地重组。
note.en: 'Paid' is interpretive; the source says the army was reorganized on a more permanent basis.

statement.zh: 奥尔汗还在布鲁萨和新占领城市修建清真寺、宗教学校与商队旅舍。城市把军事收益转成可延续的制度，而不只是下一次劫掠的本钱。
statement.en: Orhan also built mosques, theological colleges and caravansaries in Bursa and newly conquered towns. The city turned military revenue into durable institutions rather than capital for the next raid.

sources.excerpt: Orhan built mosques, medreses (theological colleges), and caravansaries in the newly conquered towns, particularly the Ottoman capital, Bursa, which later became a major Islamic centre.

zh: 奥尔汗还在布鲁萨和新占领城市修建清真寺、宗教学校与商队旅舍。城市把军事收益转成可延续的制度，而不只是下一次劫掠的本钱。
en: Orhan also built mosques, theological colleges and caravansaries in Bursa and newly conquered towns. The city turned military revenue into durable institutions rather than capital for the next raid.

note.zh: 建筑清单按来源；结论是作者解释。
note.en: The building list follows the source; the conclusion is interpretive.

title.zh: 两都之战：元朝皇室内战

summary.zh: 泰定帝病逝，留守大都的燕铁木儿拥立元武宗之子图帖睦尔（文宗）为帝，而在上都的权臣倒剌沙则立泰定帝幼子阿剌吉八（天顺帝）。双方爆发内战，燕铁木儿攻克上都，天顺帝不知所终。文宗获胜但统治基础脆弱。

statement.zh: 泰定帝病逝，留守大都的燕铁木儿拥立元武宗之子图帖睦尔（文宗）为帝，而在上都的权臣倒剌沙则立泰定帝幼子阿剌吉八（天顺帝）。双方爆发内战，燕铁木儿攻克上都，天顺帝不知所终。文宗获胜但统治基础脆弱。
statement.en:
Emperor Taiding died. In Dadu, El Temür enthroned Tugh Temür (Emperor Wenzong), a son of Khayishan, while in Shangdu, Daolat Shah enthroned Taiding's young son Aragibag (Emperor Tianshun). The two sides fought a civil war. El Temür captured Shangdu, and Emperor Tianshun disappeared. Wenzong won, but his rule rested on a weak foundation.

For Asia in 1328, “War of the Two Capitals: Yuan imperial civil war” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

The two sides fought a civil war. El Temür captured Shangdu, and Emperor Tianshun disappeared. Wenzong won, but his rule rested on a weak foundation.
Emperor Taiding died.

title.zh: 元文宗毒杀兄明宗夺位

summary.zh: 元文宗迫于舆论曾迎立其兄和世㻋（明宗）为帝，但明宗即位仅7天即暴死，疑为文宗和燕铁木儿毒杀。文宗复立，大肆屠杀明宗旧臣。这次“天历之变”使元朝皇室道德彻底沦丧。

title.zh: 马里帝国曼萨·穆萨朝圣返程并大兴建筑

summary.zh: 曼萨·穆萨从麦加返回，带回阿拉伯学者和建筑师，在廷巴克图修建津格里贝尔大清真寺和桑科尔大学，使该城成为西非伊斯兰学术中心。

statement.zh: 曼萨·穆萨从麦加返回，带回阿拉伯学者和建筑师，在廷巴克图修建津格里贝尔大清真寺和桑科尔大学，使该城成为西非伊斯兰学术中心。朝圣把西非与伊斯兰世界连接，学者与建筑随行旅进入撒哈拉南缘；清真寺与大学把宗教、法律与教育结合。廷巴克图成为知识与商路的枢纽。
statement.en: Mansa Musa returned from Mecca and brought back Arab scholars and architects to build the Zingribel Grand Mosque and Sankor University in Timbuktu, making the city the center of Islamic learning in West Africa.

title.zh: 汪大渊远航西洋

summary.zh: 元代航海家汪大渊两度由泉州出海，遍历东南亚、南亚、阿拉伯与东非沿岸，归著《岛夷志略》记海外诸国。

statement.zh:
元代航海家汪大渊两度由泉州出海，遍历东南亚、南亚、阿拉伯与东非沿岸，归著《岛夷志略》记海外诸国。他随商船航行，记录各地的港口、物产、货币与风俗，兼及航路与季风；书中所见可与其亲身经历与转述相互参照。它为元代的海上贸易留下系统记载。

把「汪大渊远航西洋」放回1330年的南海，可以看到探索变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Wang Dayuan, a navigator of the Yuan Dynasty, went to sea from Quanzhou twice, traveled through Southeast Asia, South Asia, Arabia and the coast of East Africa, and wrote "Dao Yi Zhi Lue" to record overseas countries.

title.zh: 瑞典《埃里克编年史》成书

summary.zh: 约1320至1335年间，一位佚名作者用古瑞典语写成韵文编年史《埃里克编年史》（Erikskrönikan），全诗四千五百余行，采用当时德意志骑士文学流行的短押韵句体。它记述1229年至1319年的瑞典历史，中心人物是宾雅尔博（福尔孔）王朝的埃里克公爵——1317年他与兄长瓦尔德马尔被国王比尔耶尔诱至尼雪平赴宴，遭囚禁饿死，史称“尼雪平宴会”；两年后埃里克之

statement.zh: 约1320至1335年间，一位佚名作者用古瑞典语写成韵文编年史《埃里克编年史》（Erikskrönikan），全诗四千五百余行，采用当时德意志骑士文学流行的短押韵句体。
statement.en: Between about 1320 and 1335 an anonymous author composed Erikskrönikan, Sweden's first substantial rhymed chronicle: some 4,500 lines of Old Swedish in the short couplets then fashionable in German chivalric verse.

title.zh: 伊本·白图泰游历非洲

summary.zh: 1330年代，摩洛哥学者伊本·白图泰游历北非、东非与西非，远抵印度与中国，归后口述《游记》，是世界中世纪最重要的旅行记录之一。

statement.zh: 1330年代，摩洛哥学者伊本·白图泰游历北非、东非与西非，远抵印度与中国，归后口述《游记》，是世界中世纪最重要的旅行记录之一。他以法学家的身份往来于商路与宫廷，观察市镇、宗教与风俗；口述由他人笔录成书，兼具见闻与传闻。游记为后世留下跨地域的日常图景。
statement.en: In the 1330s, the Moroccan scholar Ibn Battuta traveled to North Africa, East Africa, and West Africa, reaching as far away as India and China.

title.zh: 意大利复式簿记出现

summary.zh: 佛罗伦萨银行家采用借方/贷方复式记账法，并推广阿拉伯数字。这种会计革命使商人能精确计算盈亏，推动资本主义萌芽。

statement.zh:
佛罗伦萨银行家采用借方/贷方复式记账法，并推广阿拉伯数字。这种会计革命使商人能精确计算盈亏，推动资本主义萌芽。复式记账把每笔交易同时记入两方，账目可交叉核对，合伙与信贷因此更易管理；数字与账簿成为商业决策的工具。会计技术支撑了商业扩张。

把「意大利复式簿记出现」放回1330年的佛罗伦萨，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Florentine bankers adopted debit/credit double-entry accounting and popularized Arabic numerals.

title.zh: 瓦拉几亚公国建立

summary.zh: 巴斯arab一世建立瓦拉几亚公国，据喀尔巴阡山与多瑙河之间，成为罗马尼亚诸公国之一。

statement.zh:
巴萨拉布一世建立瓦拉几亚公国，据喀尔巴阡山与多瑙河之间，成为罗马尼亚诸公国之一。公国以王公与贵族议事治理，处在多瑙河下游的通道上，既要面对游牧与邻国的压力，也参与区域贸易。与摩尔多瓦、特兰西瓦尼亚的并立，构成罗马尼亚诸公国的政治格局。

把「瓦拉几亚公国建立」放回1330年的瓦拉几亚，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Basarab I founded Wallachia between the Carpathians and the Danube, one of the Romanian principalities.

title.zh: 塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·杜尚篡位

summary.zh: 斯特凡·杜尚推翻其父斯特凡·乌罗什三世自立，随后大力改革军队，入侵拜占庭帝国，很快将建立塞尔维亚帝国。

statement.zh: 斯特凡·杜尚推翻其父斯特凡·乌罗什三世自立，随后大力改革军队，入侵拜占庭帝国，很快将建立塞尔维亚帝国。他借助拜占庭内乱扩张，向马其顿与色雷斯推进，并仿照拜占庭制度整顿地方行政与税制。采邑与军役的结合增强了中央的兵源，也加深了贵族对王权的依附。塞尔维亚由此从区域王国走向巴尔干强权。
statement.en: Stefan Dushan overthrew his father, Stefan Uroš III, and established himself on his own.

title.zh: 苏格兰-法国“老同盟”条约续签

summary.zh: 苏格兰与法国签订《凡尔登条约》，重申互相支持对抗英格兰。法国向苏格兰提供军事援助，苏格兰则牵制英格兰北部。该同盟延续了数百年。

statement.zh:

title.zh: 元文宗驾崩，权臣燕铁木儿立幼主

summary.zh: 元文宗病逝，遗愿传位给明宗之子。但权臣燕铁木儿为继续专权，立年仅7岁的懿璘质班（宁宗）。宁宗即位43天后夭折，燕铁木儿又立明宗长子妥懽帖睦尔（顺帝），元朝进入末年。

statement.zh: 元文宗病逝，遗愿传位给明宗之子。但权臣燕铁木儿为继续专权，立年仅7岁的懿璘质班（宁宗）。宁宗即位43天后夭折，燕铁木儿又立明宗长子妥懽帖睦尔（顺帝），元朝进入末年。
statement.en:
Emperor Wenzong died, leaving a will to pass the throne to a son of Emperor Mingzong. But the powerful minister El Temür, to perpetuate his power, enthroned the seven‑year‑old Rinchinbal (Emperor Ningzong). After only 43 days, Ningzong died. El Temür then enthroned Mingzong's eldest son, Toghon Temür (Emperor Shundi), and the Yuan entered its final years.

For Asia in 1332, “Emperor Wenzong dies; strongman El Temür installs a child emperor” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元顺帝即位，燕铁木儿专权

summary.zh: 元顺帝妥懽帖睦尔13岁即位，权臣燕铁木儿继续把持朝政，生活荒淫，朝政败坏。顺帝隐忍不发，等待机会铲除权臣。

statement.zh:
元顺帝妥懽帖睦尔13岁即位，权臣燕铁木儿继续把持朝政，生活荒淫，朝政败坏。顺帝隐忍不发，等待机会铲除权臣。幼主即位使权臣得以垄断人事与禁军，宫廷奢侈与财政亏空相互加剧；皇帝以隐忍积蓄亲政资本。元廷的内部裂痕由此加深。

把「元顺帝即位，燕铁木儿专权」放回1333年的元，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Emperor Shundi (Toghon Temür) came to the throne at age 13, while the powerful minister El Temür continued to monopolise power, living in debauchery and allowing government to decay.

title.zh: 元朝顺德路白莲教起义

summary.zh: 白莲教徒在河北顺德路举事，杀官烧衙，迅速被镇压。但这是元末大规模农民起义的预演，韩山童、刘福通等人从中汲取经验。

statement.zh: 白莲教徒在河北顺德路举事，杀官烧衙，迅速被镇压。但这是元末大规模农民起义的预演，韩山童、刘福通等人从中汲取经验。
statement.en:
White Lotus followers rose in Shunde, Hebei, killing officials and burning offices, but were quickly suppressed. This was a prelude to the massive peasant uprisings at the end of the Yuan. Han Shantong and Liu Futong gained experience from it.

For Asia in 1334, “White Lotus rebellion in Shunde, Yuan” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 足利尊氏反叛后醍醐天皇，建立室町幕府

summary.zh: 足利尊氏因不满建武新政偏向公卿，举兵反叛。他攻占京都，后醍醐天皇逃往吉野，形成南北朝对峙。足利尊氏在京都另立光明天皇，被封为征夷大将军，正式建立室町幕府（1338年）。

statement.zh: 足利尊氏因不满建武新政偏向公卿，举兵反叛。他攻占京都，后醍醐天皇逃往吉野，形成南北朝对峙。足利尊氏在京都另立光明天皇，被封为征夷大将军，正式建立室町幕府（1338年）。
statement.en:
Dissatisfied with the Kenmu Restoration's favouritism toward court nobles, Ashikaga Takauji raised an army, captured Kyōto, and forced Go-Daigo to flee to Yoshino, creating a Northern and Southern Courts period. Takauji installed Emperor Kōmyō in Kyōto, was appointed Seii Taishōgun, and formally established the Ashikaga shogunate (1338).

For Asia in 1335, “Ashikaga Takauji rebels against Emperor Go-Daigo, establishing the Ashikaga shogunate” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元朝开河大会试

summary.zh: 元朝至元四年（公元1338年），元顺帝下诏开河（整治黄河）并举行科举会试。元朝科举在延祐复科后时断时续。1338年的会试录取了约百名进士。但元末政治腐败导致科举选官的作用有限。

statement.zh: 元朝至元4年（公元1338年），元顺帝下诏开河（整治黄河）并举行科举会试。元朝科举在延祐复科后时断时续。1338年的会试录取了约百名进士。但元末政治腐败导致科举选官的作用有限。
statement.en:
In 1338 (Zhiyuan 4), Emperor Shundi ordered river control (Yellow River regulation) and held the metropolitan exam. Since the restoration under Yanyou, the Yuan exams had been intermittent. The 1338 exam enrolled about 100 jinshi, but by the late Yuan, political corruption had made the exam's role in selecting officials limited.

For Asia in 1338, “Yuan opens river control and holds metropolitan examination” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 英国议会通过法令限制教皇权力

summary.zh: 爱德华三世为摆脱教廷控制，通过《王权法案》，禁止英国人向教廷上诉、禁止教皇任命主教。这是英国国教独立的重要一步。

statement.zh:
爱德华三世为摆脱教廷控制，通过《王权法案》，禁止英国人向教廷上诉、禁止教皇任命主教。这是英国国教独立的重要一步。法案把司法与人事权收归王权，教廷税收与任命由此受限；王权与教会的张力转向民族教会方向。政教关系进入新阶段。

把「英国议会通过法令限制教皇权力」放回1339年的英格兰，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Edward III, seeking to free England from papal control, passed the Statute of Provisors, forbidding appeals to the Pope and papal appointments of bishops.

title.zh: 黄河白茅口决堤，元朝开始治理

summary.zh: 黄河在白茅口（今山东曹县）决堤，洪水漫溢，淹没大片土地，影响漕运。元朝派遣工部尚书成遵治理，但耗费巨大，加重了百姓负担，成为红巾军起义诱因之一。

title.zh: 斯勒伊斯海战：英格兰击溃法国舰队

title.zh: 坎塔库泽努斯内战

summary.zh: 约翰六世与幼帝约翰五世的摄政集团开战，双方竞相引塞尔维亚人与土耳其人为援，奥斯曼军队由此首次踏足欧洲。

statement.zh:
约翰六世与幼帝约翰五世的摄政集团开战，双方竞相引塞尔维亚人与土耳其人为援，奥斯曼军队由此首次踏足欧洲。内战以宫廷摄政与贵族联盟的对立为线，色雷斯与马其顿成为战场；雇佣与盟约把外部势力引入半岛。战争消耗了帝国的财力与防务。

把「坎塔库泽努斯内战」放回1341年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: John VI went to war with the regent group of the young emperor John V.

title.zh: 元朝修辽、金、宋三史工程启动

summary.zh: 脱脱奏请元顺帝，成立史局，正式纂修辽、金、宋三部正史。脱脱主张三朝各为正统，打破了历史上“尊宋抑辽金”的偏见。

statement.zh:
脱脱奏请元顺帝，成立史局，正式纂修辽、金、宋三部正史。脱脱主张三朝各为正统，打破了历史上“尊宋抑辽金”的偏见。修史以官方档案与前朝记录为基础，分立三书又共享体例；正统之争关系到元朝自身的合法性承继。史学编纂成为政治表态。

把「元朝修辽、金、宋三史工程启动」放回1342年的元，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Toqto'a petitioned Emperor Shundi to establish a history bureau and begin the official compilation of the histories of the Liao, Jin, and Song dynasties.

title.zh: 元朝红巾军起义前兆：白莲教秘密活动

summary.zh: 白莲教首领韩山童、刘福通在黄河工地预埋独眼石人，散布“石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反”的民谣。起义一触即发。

statement.zh: 白莲教首领韩山童、刘福通在黄河工地预埋独眼石人，散布“石人一只眼，挑动黄河天下反”的民谣。起义一触即发。治河征发大量民夫，工地成为秘密结社动员的场所；石人与谶语把宗教预言转为政治号召，借天意动员人心。元廷对民间教门的禁令反而强化了地下网络。
statement.en: White Lotus leaders Han Shantong and Liu Futong buried a one‑eyed stone man near the Yellow River construction site, spreading the rhyme: 'One‑eyed stone man, stir the Yellow River, and all under Heaven will rebel.' The uprising was imminent.

title.zh: 元朝脱脱辞职，黄河泛滥加剧

summary.zh: 元至正四年（1344年），黄河在曹州、济宁等地决口，洪水泛滥数百里，淹没大量农田和村庄。时任中书右丞相的脱脱因与元顺帝的矛盾被迫辞职，黄河治理工程无人主持。朝廷财政拮据无法有效赈灾，灾民流离失所。黄河泛滥和赈灾不力直接加剧了社会矛盾，各地起义相继爆发。1351年脱脱复出后主持治理黄河。

statement.zh: 元至正4年（1344年），黄河在曹州、济宁等地决口，洪水泛滥数百里，淹没大量农田和村庄。时任中书右丞相的脱脱因与元顺帝的矛盾被迫辞职，黄河治理工程无人主持。朝廷财政拮据无法有效赈灾，灾民流离失所。黄河泛滥和赈灾不力直接加剧了社会矛盾，各地起义相继爆发。1351年脱脱复出后主持治理黄河。
statement.en:
In 1344 (Zhizheng 4), the Yellow River breached its banks at Caozhou and Jining, flooding hundreds of li and destroying countless farms and villages. Right Chancellor Toqto'a, due to conflicts with Emperor Shundi, was forced to resign, leaving river control unattended. The court, short of funds, could not provide effective relief, and refugees wandered. The flooding and inadequate relief intensified social conflicts, leading to widespread uprisings. Toqto'a returned in 1351 to lead river control.

For Asia in 1344, “Toqto'a resigns; Yellow River flooding worsens” is a traceable node of Disaster change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元朝方国珍起义，元末农民战争序幕

summary.zh: 台州人方国珍因仇家诬告，杀仇人后逃亡海上，聚众数千，劫掠漕运。元朝派兵讨伐屡败。这是元末第一个大规模起义，拉开了全国性起义的序幕。

statement.zh: 台州人方国珍因仇家诬告，杀仇人后逃亡海上，聚众数千，劫掠漕运。元朝派兵讨伐屡败。这是元末第一个大规模起义，拉开了全国性起义的序幕。
statement.en:
Fang Guozhen, a man from Taizhou, was falsely accused by an enemy, killed his accuser, and fled to sea, gathering several 1000 followers to raid grain transport. The Yuan expeditions against him repeatedly failed. This was the first large‑scale rebellion of the late Yuan, setting off a wave of nationwide uprisings.

For Asia in 1346, “Fang Guozhen's rebellion in Yuan, curtain‑raiser to the end‑of‑Yuan peasant wars” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 黑死病从卡法传到西西里，欧洲噩梦开始

summary.zh: 蒙古金帐汗国围攻热那亚商港卡法时，用投石机将鼠疫死者尸体抛入城内。幸存的热那亚商人逃回西西里墨西拿，黑死病由此传入欧洲，此后数年夺走2500万人生命（占欧洲1/3人口）。欧洲社会结构被彻底颠覆。

title.zh: 黑死病侵袭君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 瘟疫沿黑海商路传入都城，人口大量死亡，帝国本已枯竭的兵源与税基遭受又一重击。

statement.zh:
瘟疫沿黑海商路传入都城，人口大量死亡，帝国本已枯竭的兵源与税基遭受又一重击。商路与船运使疫病跨区域扩散，城市人口密集又让死亡集中；对拜占庭而言，劳动力与税收的损失加深了军事与财政的困境。瘟疫因此不只是公共卫生事件，也成为帝国衰势的一部分。

把「黑死病侵袭君士坦丁堡」放回1347年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到灾难变化的一个具体切面。

title.zh: 元朝封脱脱为太师，复相

summary.zh: 元至正七年（1347年），元顺帝重新起用脱脱为右丞相，加封太师。脱脱此前因政治斗争被罢免。复相后他推行了一些改革措施，包括主持编纂辽金宋三史和治理黄河。但由于元末政治腐败和财政崩溃，改革难以奏效。

statement.zh: 元至正7年（1347年），元顺帝重新起用脱脱为右丞相，加封太师。脱脱此前因政治斗争被罢免。复相后他推行了一些改革措施，包括主持编纂辽金宋三史和治理黄河。但由于元末政治腐败和财政崩溃，改革难以奏效。
statement.en:
In 1347 (Zhizheng 7), Emperor Shundi reappointed Toqto'a as right chancellor and Grand Tutor. Toqto'a had been dismissed earlier due to political struggles. After returning, he introduced some reform measures, including overseeing the compilation of the Liao, Jin, and Song histories and controlling the Yellow River. However, due to political corruption and fiscal collapse, the reforms had little effect.

For Asia in 1347, “Yuan appoints Toqto'a as Grand Tutor and restores him as chancellor” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 元朝发行至正交钞，恶性通胀爆发

summary.zh: 元朝为解决财政危机大量印钞，纸币贬值，物价飞涨。民间拒绝使用纸币，恢复以物易物。经济崩溃加速了元朝灭亡。

statement.zh:
元朝为解决财政危机大量印钞，纸币贬值，物价飞涨。民间拒绝使用纸币，恢复以物易物。经济崩溃加速了元朝灭亡。新钞发行缺乏准备金与回收机制，旧钞折兑又加重混乱；税收与军费依赖印钞，形成恶性循环。

把「元朝发行至正交钞，恶性通胀爆发」放回1348年的元，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: In order to solve the financial crisis, the Yuan Dynasty printed a large amount of money, resulting in devaluation of banknotes and soaring prices.

title.zh: 元朝脱脱治理黄河

summary.zh: 脱脱亲自主持黄河疏浚工程，征发15万民工，修复白茅口决口。但官员克扣粮饷，民工怨声载道，为红巾军起义提供了导火索。

脱脱亲自主持黄河疏浚工程，征发15万民工，修复白茅口决口。但官员克扣粮饷，民工怨声载道，为红巾军起义提供了导火索。工程以堵口、疏浚与堤防为主，征夫集中于工地，劳役与赈济的承诺落空；民怨与秘密结社结合。治河由此成为社会动荡的引线。

statement.en: Toqto'a personally directed the dredging of the Yellow River, conscripting 150,000 labourers to repair the Baimaokou breach.

title.zh: 印加帝国开始大规模扩张

summary.zh: 印加君主帕查库特克（约此时）开始改革军队，扩张领土，征服安第斯山周围部落。印加从库斯科小邦转变为南美洲帝国。

statement.zh:
印加君主帕查库特克（约此时）开始改革军队，扩张领土，征服安第斯山周围部落。印加从库斯科小邦转变为南美洲帝国。山地地形与道路体系支撑兵力调动，移民与屯田把新征服区纳入统治；王权以神庙与行政中心整合多部族。安第斯的政治格局由此改变。

statement.en: Inca ruler Pachacuti (around this time) began reforming the army and expanding territory, conquering tribes around the Andes.

title.zh: 红巾军起义爆发，元末大乱

summary.zh: 白莲教首领韩山童、刘福通在颍州（今安徽阜阳）宣誓起义，因头裹红巾称“红巾军”。他们打出“虎贲三千，直抵幽燕之地”口号，攻占多座城市。各地纷纷响应，徐寿辉、郭子兴等相继起义，元朝统治摇摇欲坠。

statement.zh: 白莲教首领韩山童、刘福通在颍州（今安徽阜阳）宣誓起义，因头裹红巾称“红巾军”。他们打出“虎贲三千，直抵幽燕之地”口号，攻占多座城市。各地纷纷响应，徐寿辉、郭子兴等相继起义，元朝统治摇摇欲坠。
statement.en:
White Lotus leaders Han Shantong and Liu Futong launched an uprising at Yingzhou (now Fuyang, Anhui), wearing red headscarves, hence 'Red Turban Army'. They proclaimed the slogan 'Three thousand tigers, straight to the land of Youyan', capturing several cities. Responses came from all sides; Xu Shouhui, Guo Zixing, and others rose up. Yuan rule teetered.

For Asia in 1351, “Red Turban Rebellion erupts, Yuan descends into chaos” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 朱元璋投奔郭子兴起义军

summary.zh: 郭子兴在濠州起义，朱元璋受汤和邀请加入，任亲兵九夫长。他作战勇敢、粗通文墨，被郭子兴招为女婿（娶马氏），从此崭露头角。

statement.zh: 郭子兴在濠州起义，朱元璋受汤和邀请加入，任亲兵九夫长。他作战勇敢、粗通文墨，被郭子兴招为女婿（娶马氏），从此崭露头角。
statement.en:
Guo Zixing rebelled in Haozhou. Zhu Yuanzhang, invited by Tang He, joined as a commander of a nine‑man squad. Brave and somewhat literate, Zhu was taken as a son‑in‑law by Guo (marrying Ma Shi), thus beginning his rise.

For Asia in 1352, “Zhu Yuanzhang joins Guo Zixing's rebel army” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 欧洲大学争取自治权

summary.zh: 巴黎大学师生与巴黎市民冲突后，向教宗请求特权，获准独立于城市司法。大学自治原则逐渐确立，为学术自由提供保障。

statement.zh:
巴黎大学师生与巴黎市民冲突后，向教宗请求特权，获准独立于城市司法。大学自治原则逐渐确立，为学术自由提供保障。师生以行会方式组织，教学与学位授予自成体系；教宗特权使大学在教会与王权之间获得空间。自治传统影响后世欧洲大学。

把「欧洲大学争取自治权」放回1352年的法国，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: After a conflict between the University of Paris and the citizens, the university petitioned the pope for privileges and obtained exemption from the city's jurisdiction.

title.zh: 伊本·白图泰抵马里

summary.zh: 摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰行至马里帝国京城，记其富强与廷巴克图学术。

statement.zh: 伊本·白图泰在14世纪中叶到访马里，记录了宫廷礼仪、市场、司法和当地妇女地位。
statement.en: Ibn Battuta visited Mali in the mid-fourteenth century and recorded court ritual, markets, justice and the position of women.

title.zh: 朱元璋攻占滁州，建立根据地

summary.zh: 朱元璋率部攻占滁州，以此为中心，整顿军纪，招纳李善长、徐达、常遇春等人才。他的势力逐渐脱离郭子兴，开始独立发展。

statement.zh:
朱元璋率部攻占滁州，以此为中心，整顿军纪，招纳李善长、徐达、常遇春等人才。他的势力逐渐脱离郭子兴，开始独立发展。滁州地处江淮之间，粮道与地势便于屯驻；文士谋划、武将征战，军政组织渐成。红巾军中一支新的力量由此崛起。

把「朱元璋攻占滁州，建立根据地」放回1354年的元，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Zhu Yuanzhang's forces took Chuzhou and used it as a centre, disciplining the army and recruiting talents such as Li Shanchang, Xu Da and Chang Yuchun.

title.zh: 奥斯曼跨过达达尼尔，加里波利成为欧洲桥头堡

summary.zh: 1354年，奥尔汗之子苏莱曼帕夏跨过达达尼尔海峡，夺取加里波利半岛；部分参考书写“约1356年”。加里波利是奥斯曼在欧洲的第一个永久据点，也是海军基地与巴尔干—安纳托利亚之间的中转站。

statement.zh: 1354年，奥尔汗之子苏莱曼帕夏跨过达达尼尔海峡，夺取加里波利半岛。部分参考书写“约1356年”，差别来自对征服过程的断代。
statement.en: In 1354 Süleyman Pasha, son of Orhan, crossed the Dardanelles and took the Gallipoli peninsula. Some references give 'about 1356'; the difference comes from how the conquest is dated.

sources.excerpt: As John VI's ally, Orhan married Theodora, John's daughter, and acquired the right to conduct raids in the Balkans. His campaigns provided the Ottomans with an intimate knowledge of the area, and in 1354 they seized Gallipoli as a permanent foothold in Europe.
An important Byzantine fortress, it was the first Ottoman conquest (c. 1356) in Europe and was maintained as a naval base because of its strategic importance for the defense of Istanbul.

zh: 1354年，奥尔汗之子苏莱曼帕夏跨过达达尼尔海峡，夺取加里波利半岛。部分参考书写“约1356年”，差别来自对征服过程的断代。
en: In 1354 Süleyman Pasha, son of Orhan, crossed the Dardanelles and took the Gallipoli peninsula. Some references give 'about 1356'; the difference comes from how the conquest is dated.

note.zh: 并列 1354 与约 1356 两说；不写地震弃城等细节。
note.en: Both 1354 and c. 1356 are given; no earthquake-abandonment detail is added.

statement.zh: 加里波利不是一次普通劫掠。它把奥斯曼军队送到欧洲一侧，并成为向巴尔干袭掠的永久基地；这里后来被维护为海军基地，也是鲁米利亚与安纳托利亚之间的贸易中转站。
statement.en: Gallipoli was not an ordinary raid. It put Ottoman forces on the European side and became a permanent base for raids into the Balkans; it was later maintained as a naval base and as a transit station between Rumelia and Anatolia.

sources.excerpt: An important Byzantine fortress, it was the first Ottoman conquest (c. 1356) in Europe and was maintained as a naval base because of its strategic importance for the defense of Istanbul. It was also a key transit station on the trade routes from Rumelia (Ottoman possessions in the Balkans) to Anatolia.
His campaigns provided the Ottomans with an intimate knowledge of the area, and in 1354 they seized Gallipoli as a permanent foothold in Europe.

zh: 加里波利不是一次普通劫掠。它把奥斯曼军队送到欧洲一侧，并成为向巴尔干袭掠的永久基地；这里后来被维护为海军基地，也是鲁米利亚与安纳托利亚之间的贸易中转站。
en: Gallipoli was not an ordinary raid. It put Ottoman forces on the European side and became a permanent base for raids into the Balkans; it was later maintained as a naval base and as a transit station between Rumelia and Anatolia.

note.zh: 海军基地与贸易中转站是 Gallipoli 条目明确写的。
note.en: The naval base and transit station are explicit in the Gallipoli entry.

statement.zh: 从这里出发，奥斯曼介入色雷斯、马其顿与巴尔干的继承战争。欧洲的土地、税收与附庸，逐渐比安纳托利亚边境更重要。
statement.en: From there the Ottomans intervened in the succession wars of Thrace, Macedonia and the Balkans. European land, taxation and vassals gradually mattered more than the Anatolian frontier.

sources.excerpt: Orhan's reign (1324–60) marked the beginning of Ottoman expansion into the Balkans. His campaigns provided the Ottomans with an intimate knowledge of the area, and in 1354 they seized Gallipoli as a permanent foothold in Europe.

zh: 从这里出发，奥斯曼介入色雷斯、马其顿与巴尔干的继承战争。欧洲的土地、税收与附庸，逐渐比安纳托利亚边境更重要。
en: From there the Ottomans intervened in the succession wars of Thrace, Macedonia and the Balkans. European land, taxation and vassals gradually mattered more than the Anatolian frontier.

note.zh: “继承战争”是概括；来源只说扩张进入巴尔干并提供当地知识。
note.en: 'Succession wars' is a summary; the source says expansion into the Balkans and intimate local knowledge.

statement.zh: 但桥头堡本身不是帝国。它需要后方提供兵员、粮食和船只；一旦海峡失守，欧洲据点就会变成孤岛。
statement.en: But a bridgehead is not an empire. It needed manpower, food and ships from the rear; if the straits were lost, the European foothold would become an isolated island.

zh: 但桥头堡本身不是帝国。它需要后方提供兵员、粮食和船只；一旦海峡失守，欧洲据点就会变成孤岛。
en: But a bridgehead is not an empire. It needed manpower, food and ships from the rear; if the straits were lost, the European foothold would become an isolated island.

note.zh: 作者判断：强调桥头堡的后勤脆弱性。
note.en: Author judgment: stresses the logistical fragility of a bridgehead.

title.zh: 教宗英诺森六世试图将教廷迁回罗马

summary.zh: 阿尔伯恩主教受教宗派遣前往意大利，重建教宗权威，为格里高利十一世最终迁回罗马铺路。但阿维尼翁教廷仍受法国控制。

statement.zh:
阿尔伯恩主教受教宗派遣前往意大利，重建教宗权威，为格里高利十一世最终迁回罗马铺路。但阿维尼翁教廷仍受法国控制。使节以军事与外交手段收复教产、整顿地方政权，逐步恢复教宗国的秩序；法国王室的影响仍限制教廷的独立。教廷返回罗马是长期博弈的结果。

把「教宗英诺森六世试图将教廷迁回罗马」放回1354年的教皇国，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Cardinal Albornoz was sent to Italy to restore papal authority, paving the way for Gregory XI's eventual return to Rome.

title.zh: 神圣罗马帝国查理四世颁布《金玺诏书》

summary.zh: 查理四世在纽伦堡和梅斯帝国议会颁布《金玺诏书》，规定七大选帝侯（美因茨、特里尔、科隆大主教，波西米亚国王，莱茵普法尔茨伯爵，萨克森公爵，勃兰登堡藩侯）拥有选举皇帝的全权，帝国正式承认选帝侯制的合法性，中央集权宣告失败。

statement.zh: 查理四世在纽伦堡和梅斯帝国议会颁布《金玺诏书》，规定七大选帝侯（美因茨、特里尔、科隆大主教，波西米亚国王，莱茵普法尔茨伯爵，萨克森公爵，勃兰登堡藩侯）拥有选举皇帝的全权，帝国正式承认选帝侯制的合法性，中央集权宣告失败。
statement.en:
At the Diets of Nuremberg and Metz, Charles IV issued the Golden Bull, specifying that the seven prince‑electors (the archbishops of Mainz, Trier, and Cologne, the King of Bohemia, the Count Palatine of the Rhine, the Duke of Saxony, and the Margrave of Brandenburg) had the exclusive right to elect the emperor. The empire thus formally recognised the elector system, and centralisation failed.

For Europe in 1355, “Emperor Charles IV of the Holy Roman Empire issues the Golden Bull” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

en: At the Diets of Nuremberg and Metz, Charles IV issued the Golden Bull, specifying that the seven prince‑electors (the archbishops of Mainz, Trier, and Cologne, the King of Bohemia, the Count Palatine of the Rhine, the Duke of Saxony, and the Margrave of Brandenburg) had the exclusive right to elect the emperor. The empire thus formally recognised the elector system, and centralisation failed.

title.zh: 恭愍王反元改革

summary.zh: 恭愍王趁元朝衰乱诛除亲元权门，废征东行省理问所，出兵收复双城总管府，恢复高丽旧制与自主。

statement.zh:
恭愍王趁元朝衰乱诛除亲元权门，废征东行省理问所，出兵收复双城总管府，恢复高丽旧制与自主。他任用新进官僚，整顿宿卫与田制，试图削弱亲元势力并收回被占土地；改革触怒既得利益集团，宫廷与军将的冲突随之加深。此后高丽在元明更替中重新选择立场。

把「恭愍王反元改革」放回1356年的高丽，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: King Gongmin took advantage of the decline of the Yuan Dynasty to eliminate the powerful pro-Yuan clan, abolished the Dongxing Provincial Inquisition Office, sent troops to recover the Shuangcheng General Office, and restored the old system and independence of Goryeo.

title.zh: 红巾军北伐三路大军攻元

summary.zh: 刘福通分三路北伐：东路军毛贵攻山东；中路军关先生、破头潘攻山西；西路军白不信攻陕西。东路军一度逼近大都，但元朝依靠察罕帖木儿等地主武装反击，红巾军最终失败。

title.zh: 法国札克雷起义

summary.zh: 百年战争导致法国农村饱受掠夺，农民爆发大规模起义（“札克雷”意为“乡下佬”）。起义者杀死贵族、烧毁城堡，后被贵族军队残酷镇压。

statement.zh: 百年战争导致法国农村饱受掠夺，农民爆发大规模起义（“札克雷”意为“乡下佬”）。起义者杀死贵族、烧毁城堡，后被贵族军队残酷镇压。战费与劫掠加于乡村，赋役与人身依附使农民积怨深重；起义缺乏组织与统一号令，很快被骑士与雇佣军击破，事后王权反而借平乱强化秩序。
statement.en: The Hundred Years' War led to the plundering of the French countryside and the outbreak of large-scale peasant uprisings ("Zaclay" means "country bumpkin").

statement.en: The rebels killed the nobles and burned the castle, and were brutally suppressed by the noble army.

title.zh: 法国太子查理镇压巴黎市民起义

summary.zh: 巴黎商会会长艾蒂安·马塞尔领导市民起义，迫使太子查理离开巴黎。查理在外集结军队，杀回巴黎平定起义，马塞尔被刺。法国王室权威恢复。

statement.zh:

1358年的法国，「法国太子查理镇压巴黎市民起义」属于社会领域。
statement.en: Étienne Marcel, provost of the Paris merchants, led a civic uprising that forced Crown Prince Charles to flee the city.

title.zh: 朱元璋设礼贤馆，广纳文人

summary.zh: 朱元璋在应天设立礼贤馆，邀请刘基（刘伯温）、宋濂、叶琛、章溢等浙东文人加入。刘基为他制定“先灭陈友谅，再灭张士诚，然后北伐”的战略。

statement.zh: 朱元璋在应天设立礼贤馆，邀请刘基（刘伯温）、宋濂、叶琛、章溢等浙东文人加入。刘基为他制定“先灭陈友谅，再灭张士诚，然后北伐”的战略。
statement.en:
Zhu Yuanzhang set up the Lixian Pavilion in Yingtian, inviting scholars from Zhejiang, including Liu Ji (Liu Bowen), Song Lian, Ye Chen, and Zhang Yi. Liu Ji devised the strategy: 'First destroy Chen Youliang, then eliminate Zhang Shicheng, then march north.'

For Asia in 1358, “Zhu Yuanzhang establishes a Lixian Pavilion to recruit literati” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 摩尔多瓦公国建立

summary.zh: 摩尔达武二世建立摩尔多瓦公国，据喀尔巴阡山东麓，与瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚并立。

statement.zh: 摩尔达武二世建立摩尔多瓦公国，据喀尔巴阡山东麓，与瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚并立。公国处在多瑙河下游与黑海北岸之间的通道上，因而长期受周边强权影响。建国后以王公与贵族议事为核心，在瓦拉几亚与特兰西瓦尼亚之间维持自身的政治与教会组织。这一位置既带来贸易机会，也使公国成为邻国争夺的对象，其存续与区域力量对比紧密相关。
statement.en: Bogdan I founds Moldavia east of the Carpathians, standing alongside Wallachia and Transylvania.

title.zh: 察罕帖木儿收复汴梁，红巾军受挫

summary.zh: 元朝将领察罕帖木儿（扩廓帖木儿养父）率领地主武装攻占红巾军都城汴梁，刘福通、韩林儿逃往安丰。红巾军从此一蹶不振，元廷赢得短暂喘息。

statement.zh: 元朝将领察罕帖木儿（扩廓帖木儿养父）率领地主武装攻占红巾军都城汴梁，刘福通、韩林儿逃往安丰。红巾军从此一蹶不振，元廷赢得短暂喘息。
statement.en:
Yuan general Chaghan Temür (adoptive father of Köke Temür) led his private army to capture Kaifeng, the Red Turban capital. Liu Futong and Han Lin'er fled to Anfeng. Thereafter the Red Turbans never recovered, and the Yuan court gained a brief respite.

For Asia in 1359, “Chaghan Temür recaptures Kaifeng; Red Turbans suffer a setback” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 意大利《修士之家》壁画完成

summary.zh: 安德烈亚·博纳尤蒂在佛罗伦萨新圣母大殿绘制的《修士之家》壁画，表现教会的胜利和学术的繁荣，是哥特艺术杰作。

statement.zh:
安德烈亚·博纳尤蒂在佛罗伦萨新圣母大殿绘制的《修士之家》壁画，表现教会的胜利和学术的繁荣，是哥特艺术杰作。画面以寓意人物与场景并置，把教义、学科与修会历史组织为视觉体系；赞助家族与修会的身份也嵌入其中。壁画兼有宗教宣传与知识分类的功能。

把「意大利《修士之家》壁画完成」放回1359年的佛罗伦萨，可以看到艺术变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Andrea Bonaiuti completed the frescoes in the Spanish Chapel of Santa Maria Novella in Florence, representing the triumph of the Church and the flourishing of learning – a masterpiece of Gothic art.

title.zh: 《布雷蒂尼和约》签订，百年战争休战

summary.zh: 英法签订和约：法国割让加莱、蓬蒂厄等大片领土，支付300万金克朗赎回法王约翰二世。英国放弃对法国王位的要求。但战事九年后再起。

statement.zh:
英法签订和约：法国割让加莱、蓬蒂厄等大片领土，支付300万金克朗赎回法王约翰二世。英国放弃对法国王位的要求。但战事九年后再起。和约以领土与赎金换取停战，王位要求的放弃暂时消解了战争的法理依据；未解的争端使和平难以持久。战事阶段由此划分。

把「《布雷蒂尼和约》签订，百年战争休战」放回1360年的英法，可以看到外交变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: England and France signed the treaty: France ceded Calais, Ponthieu, and other large territories and paid 3 million gold crowns to ransom King John II; England gave up its claim to the French throne.

title.zh: 奥斯曼帝国占领阿德里安堡，迁都至此

title.zh: 红巾军攻陷开京

title.zh: 文益渐引入棉种

summary.zh: 使臣文益渐自元携回棉花种子，其岳父郑天益改良纺车推广种植，棉布自此取代麻布成为半岛主要衣料。

statement.zh:
使臣文益渐自元携回棉花种子，其岳父郑天益改良纺车推广种植。引入种子与改良工具是两个不同环节：前者解决原料来源，后者决定纺纱效率；两者结合，才使棉布逐步取代麻布成为半岛主要衣料。技术传播因此不是单点事件，而是一条从引种到加工的链条。

把「文益渐引入棉种」放回1363年的高丽，可以看到农业变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The envoy Mun Ik-jeom brought cotton seeds back from Yuan China, and his father-in-law Chŏng Ch'ŏn-ik improved the spinning wheel and spread cultivation.

summary.zh: 朱元璋在应天府即吴王位，置百官，以李善长为右相国，徐达为左相国。他发布《讨张士诚檄》，明确政治目标。

title.zh: 朱元璋攻取东吴，平江之战

summary.zh: 元至正二十五年（1365年），朱元璋派徐达、常遇春率军攻取张士诚占据的东吴。平江（今苏州）是张士诚的首都。徐达围城近一年后攻破，张士诚被俘送至应天。朱元璋控制了江南最富庶的地区。

statement.zh: 元至正25年（1365年），朱元璋派徐达、常遇春率军攻取张士诚占据的东吴。平江（今苏州）是张士诚的首都。徐达围城近一年后攻破，张士诚被俘送至应天。朱元璋控制了江南最富庶的地区。
statement.en:
In 1365 (Zhizheng 25), Zhu Yuanzhang sent Xu Da and Chang Yuchun to attack the Eastern Wu held by Zhang Shicheng. Pingjiang (present‑day Suzhou), Zhang's capital, was besieged for nearly a year before falling; Zhang Shicheng was captured and brought to Yingtian. Zhu now controlled the richest region south of the Yangtze.

For Asia in 1365, “Zhu Yuanzhang captures the Eastern Wu; siege of Pingjiang” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 徐达攻克大都，元朝灭亡

summary.zh: 明军北伐顺利，八月徐达率军攻入大都（北京）。元顺帝携后妃、太子北逃上都，后奔应昌，史称“北元”。元朝在中原的统治结束，明朝统一北方。

statement.zh: 明军北伐顺利，八月徐达率军攻入大都（北京）。元顺帝携后妃、太子北逃上都，后奔应昌，史称“北元”。元朝在中原的统治结束，明朝统一北方。
statement.en:
The northern expedition went smoothly. In August, Xu Da's forces entered Dadu (Beijing). Emperor Shundi (Toghon Temür) fled north with his family, first to Shangdu and then to Yingchang, known as the 'Northern Yuan'. Yuan rule in China ended, and the Ming unified the north.

For Asia in 1368, “Xu Da captures Dadu, ending the Yuan dynasty” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝颁布《洪武通行宝钞》

summary.zh: 明朝发行大明宝钞，与铜钱并行，禁止民间使用金银。但因发行无度，很快贬值，导致民间偷用白银，为明朝货币危机埋下伏笔。

statement.zh:
明朝发行大明宝钞，与铜钱并行，禁止民间使用金银。但因发行无度，很快贬值，导致民间偷用白银，为明朝货币危机埋下伏笔。宝钞以户部印造、按面额流通，赏赐与俸禄常以钞折支；钞值下跌后物价腾贵，朝廷又以新钞折收旧钞，信用愈损。

把「明朝颁布《洪武通行宝钞》」放回1368年的明，可以看到经济变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: The Ming issued the Great Ming Treasure Note to circulate with copper coins and forbade private use of gold and silver.

title.zh: 明军攻占山西，扩廓帖木儿败退甘肃

summary.zh: 明洪武二年（1369年），徐达、常遇春率明军攻占太原。元朝大将扩廓帖木儿（王保保）兵败后逃往甘肃。明朝平定山西和陕西，基本控制了黄河以北的地区，元朝残余势力退守北方草原。

statement.zh: 明洪武2年（1369年），徐达、常遇春率明军攻占太原。元朝大将扩廓帖木儿（王保保）兵败后逃往甘肃。明朝平定山西和陕西，基本控制了黄河以北的地区，元朝残余势力退守北方草原。
statement.en:
In 1369 (Hongwu 2), Xu Da and Chang Yuchun led Ming troops to capture Taiyuan. The Yuan general Köke Temür (Wang Baobao) was defeated and fled to Gansu. title.zh: 英国威克里夫提出宗教改革思想

summary.zh: 牛津大学神学教授约翰·威克里夫开始抨击教廷腐败，主张《圣经》为最高权威、简化礼仪。他被视为“宗教改革的晨星”。

title.zh: 比萨斜塔动工

summary.zh: 意大利比萨主教座堂的独立钟楼因地基松软而逐渐倾斜，成为世界知名的斜塔奇观。

title.zh: 明朝三路北伐漠北，惨败于岭北

summary.zh: 朱元璋命徐达、李文忠、冯胜三路大军征讨北元。中路徐达在岭北（今蒙古国）遭遇北元扩廓帖木儿伏击，损失数万。东路李文忠亦不利，仅西路冯胜获胜。此战明朝意识到无法速灭北元，转为防御。

statement.zh: 朱元璋命徐达、李文忠、冯胜三路大军征讨北元。中路徐达在岭北（今蒙古国）遭遇北元扩廓帖木儿伏击，损失数万。东路李文忠亦不利，仅西路冯胜获胜。此战明朝意识到无法速灭北元，转为防御。
statement.en:
Zhu Yuanzhang ordered Xu Da, Li Wenzhong, and Feng Sheng to lead three armies against the Northern Yuan. The central army under Xu Da was ambushed at Lingbei (present‑day Mongolia) by Köke Temür, losing 10,000. Li Wenzhong's eastern army also suffered reverses. Only the western army under Feng Sheng was victorious. The Ming realised they could not quickly destroy the Northern Yuan and turned to defence.

For Asia in 1372, “Ming three‑pronged northern expedition; heavy defeat at Lingbei” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 拜占庭向奥斯曼称臣

summary.zh: 约翰五世承认苏丹宗主权，纳贡并派兵随征，昔日罗马正统沦为奥斯曼的附庸国。

statement.zh: 约翰五世承认苏丹宗主权，纳贡并派兵随征，昔日罗马正统沦为奥斯曼的附庸国。称臣使拜占庭在政治上失去独立，却在奥斯曼的体系内获得暂时的存续；纳贡与随征也把帝国的人力与资源纳入苏丹的军事机器。这一关系揭示了奥斯曼扩张的等级秩序，也为拜占庭最后的存亡埋下伏笔。
statement.en: John V recognized the suzerainty of the Sudan, paid tribute and sent troops to accompany the army.

title.zh: 明朝颁布《大明律》雏形

summary.zh: 明洪武六年（公元1373年），朱元璋命李善长、刘基等制定《大明律》。经过多次修订，《大明律》在1374年完成了初步编纂。《大明律》以《唐律》为基础，共十二篇606条。

statement.zh: 明洪武6年（公元1373年），朱元璋命李善长、刘基等制定《大明律》。经过多次修订，《大明律》在1374年完成了初步编纂。《大明律》以《唐律》为基础，共十二篇606条。
statement.en:
In 1373 (Hongwu 6), Zhu Yuanzhang ordered Li Shanchang, Liu Ji, and others to draft the Great Ming Code. After several revisions, a preliminary version was completed in 1374. Based on the Tang Code, it comprised 12 sections and 606 articles.

title.zh: 明朝设钞法司，管理纸币

summary.zh: 明洪武七年（1374年），朱元璋设立钞法司，负责大明宝钞的发行和管理。洪武八年（1375年）正式发行大明宝钞，以桑穰纸印制，面额从一百文到一贯。朱元璋试图以国家信用推行纯纸币体系，禁止金银流通。但由于没有准备金、发行量过大，宝钞迅速贬值，到15世纪中叶实际价值不到面额的十分之一。

statement.zh: 明洪武7年（1374年），朱元璋设立钞法司，负责大明宝钞的发行和管理。洪武8年（1375年）正式发行大明宝钞，以桑穰纸印制，面额从一百文到一贯。朱元璋试图以国家信用推行纯纸币体系，禁止金银流通。但由于没有准备金、发行量过大，宝钞迅速贬值，到15世纪中叶实际价值不到面额的十分之一。
statement.en:
In 1374 (Hongwu 7), Zhu Yuanzhang established the Paper Money Bureau to issue and manage the Great Ming Treasure Note. The notes, printed on mulberry‑bark paper and denominated from 100 wén to 1 guàn, were officially issued in 1375 (Hongwu 8). Zhu tried to impose a pure paper currency system, banning gold and silver, but the notes had no reserve and were over‑issued, leading to rapid depreciation. By the mid‑15th century, they were worth less than 10% of face value.

For Asia in 1374, “Ming establishes the Paper Money Bureau to manage banknotes” is a traceable node of Economy change whose significance is best read through later events.

1375年的意大利，「薄伽丘在切尔塔尔多去世」属于文化领域。
statement.en: A close friend of Petrarch and one of the 'Three Crowns' of the Renaissance, he profoundly influenced the European short story.

title.zh: 明朝废除行中书省，设承宣布政使司

summary.zh: 朱元璋宣布废除行中书省，分设承宣布政使司（民政）、提刑按察使司（司法）、都指挥使司（军事）三司，削弱地方权力，加强中央集权。

statement.zh: 朱元璋宣布废除行中书省，分设承宣布政使司（民政）、提刑按察使司（司法）、都指挥使司（军事）三司，削弱地方权力，加强中央集权。
statement.en:
Zhu Yuanzhang abolished the Branch Secretariats (xingzhongshusheng) and set up three separate offices: the Provincial Administration Commission (finance/civil affairs), the Provincial Surveillance Commission (justice), and the Provincial Military Commission (military). This weakened local power and strengthened centralisation.

For Asia in 1376, “Ming abolishes the Branch Secretariats and establishes provincial administration commissions” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 英国首次用英语进行国会开幕

summary.zh: 公元1376年（爱德华三世在位末期），被称为"贤明国会"的英国议会在开幕时首次使用英语进行演讲和辩论，而非此前的法语或拉丁语。当时英国贵族仍主要使用法语，但英语已在普通民众中广泛使用。这次会议被视为民族语言地位提升的标志，反映了百年战争期间英格兰民族意识的觉醒。1376年国会还首次引入了"弹劾"程序。

statement.en: In 1376 (the end of Edward III's reign), the so‑called 'Good Parliament' used English for its opening speeches and debates for the first time, rather than French or Latin.

title.zh: 教宗格里高利十一世将教廷从阿维尼翁迁回罗马

summary.zh: 教宗格里高利十一世在锡耶纳圣加大利纳劝诫下，离开法国控制，将教廷迁回罗马。但大多数枢机仍是法国人，为教会大分裂埋下伏笔。

statement.zh:
教宗格里高利十一世在锡耶纳圣加大利纳劝诫下，离开法国控制，将教廷迁回罗马。但大多数枢机仍是法国人，为教会大分裂埋下伏笔。迁回使教廷重获罗马的象征与财政基础，却未解决枢机团的国籍构成；法国与意大利的派系在选举中对立。教廷的分裂由此逼近。

把「教宗格里高利十一世将教廷从阿维尼翁迁回罗马」放回1377年的教皇国，可以看到宗教变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: At the urging of Catherine of Siena, Pope Gregory XI left the French‑controlled Avignon and returned the papal court to Rome.

title.zh: 明朝设通政使司，管理奏章

summary.zh: 明洪武十年（1377年），朱元璋设立通政使司，专门负责接收和传递朝廷与地方之间往来的奏章公文和臣民申诉。通政使司是明朝中央公文传送的中枢机构，但后来其权力逐渐被内阁取代。

statement.zh: 明洪武10年（1377年），朱元璋设立通政使司，专门负责接收和传递朝廷与地方之间往来的奏章公文和臣民申诉。通政使司是明朝中央公文传送的中枢机构，但后来其权力逐渐被内阁取代。
statement.en:
In 1377 (Hongwu 10), Zhu Yuanzhang set up the Transmission Office (Tongzheng Shisi) to receive and deliver memorials and appeals between the court and local authorities. It was the central channel for official documents, but its powers were later taken over by the Grand Secretariat.

For Asia in 1377, “Ming establishes the Transmission Office to manage petitions” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 《直指》金属活字印成

summary.zh: 清州兴德寺以金属活字印成《白云和尚抄录佛祖直指心体要节》，比古腾堡活字圣经早约七十八年，为现存最早金属活字印本。

statement.zh:
清州兴德寺以金属活字印成《白云和尚抄录佛祖直指心体要节》，比古腾堡活字圣经早约78年，为现存最早金属活字印本。活字铸造与排印需要专门工艺，寺院承担刻印与流通；文本以禅宗语录摘编，便于诵读。印刷技术在高丽形成独立传统。

把「《直指》金属活字印成」放回1377年的高丽，可以看到科技变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en:
"Monk Baiyun's Transcription of Buddha's Direct Points to the Heart and Body" was printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa Temple in Cheongju. It is about 78 years earlier than Gutenberg's movable type Bible and is the earliest extant metal movable type printing. The casting and printing of movable type require specialized craftsmanship, and the temple is responsible for engraving and circulation; the text is excerpted from Zen quotations for easy reading. Printing technology formed an independent tradition in Goryeo. Putting the "Ji Zhi" metal movable type printing back to Goryeo in 1377, we can see a specific aspect of technological changes.

It sits within the timeline's chronological coverage of Goryeo and technology history.

statement.zh: 明洪武11年（公元1378年），朱元璋完成了对地方行政机构的改革，将各省行省改为承宣布政使司。全国共设十三个布政使司，分管民政和财政。同时设立了按察使司和都指挥使司分管司法和军事。
statement.en:
In 1378 (Hongwu 11), Zhu Yuanzhang finalised the reform of provincial administration. The former branch secretariats were replaced by thirteen Provincial Administration Commissions, each responsible for civil and financial affairs. Separate Surveillance and Military Commissions handled justice and defence.

title.zh: 《威克里夫圣经》英译本开始翻译

summary.zh: 威克里夫支持者开始将《圣经》从拉丁文翻译成英语，这是第一部完整的英文圣经（1384年完成），促进了宗教改革。

statement.zh:
威克里夫支持者开始将《圣经》从拉丁文翻译成英语，这是第一部完整的英文圣经（1384年完成），促进了宗教改革。翻译以通行英语表达经文，使平信徒得以直接阅读；手抄本传播与后续印刷扩大影响，也招致教会的查禁。英语圣经成为改革运动的资源。

把「《威克里夫圣经》英译本开始翻译」放回1379年的英格兰，可以看到文化变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Wycliffe supporters began translating the Bible from Latin into English, which was the first complete English Bible (completed in 1384) and spurred the Reformation.

title.zh: 镇浦与荒山破倭

summary.zh: 崔茂宣以自制火炮焚毁镇浦倭船五百艘，李成桂又于荒山歼灭登岸倭寇。连年倭患得以遏止，李成桂声望大涨。

statement.zh:
崔茂宣以自制火炮焚毁镇浦倭船五百艘，李成桂又于荒山歼灭登岸倭寇。连年倭患得以遏止，李成桂声望大涨。火炮的制造与使用改变了海战方式，水军由此获得远程火力的优势；陆上作战则由骑兵与步阵配合围歼。战功使李成桂在军政两界的影响力迅速上升。

statement.en: Cui Maoxuan burned 500 Japanese ships in Zhenpu with homemade artillery, and Li Chenggui annihilated the Japanese pirates who landed in the barren mountains.

title.zh: 英国瓦特·泰勒农民起义

summary.zh: 英国因人头税爆发大规模起义，肯特和埃塞克斯农民在瓦特·泰勒、约翰·保尔率领下攻占伦敦，杀死坎特伯雷大主教。年仅14岁的理查二世与起义者谈判，在伦敦市长刺杀泰勒后，理查二世以“我是你们的国王”安抚人群，随后镇压起义。这次起义加速了英国农奴制瓦解。

title.zh: 明朝平定云南，沐英镇守

summary.zh: 明军傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率军攻入云南，击败元朝梁王。沐英留镇云南，推行屯田和儒学，使云南正式纳入明朝版图。

title.zh: 明朝设置锦衣卫

summary.zh: 朱元璋设立锦衣卫，作为皇帝私人卫队和特务机构，掌管刑狱、巡察缉捕。锦衣卫直接向皇帝负责，成为明朝政治阴影。

statement.zh:
朱元璋设立锦衣卫，作为皇帝私人卫队和特务机构，掌管刑狱、巡察缉捕。锦衣卫直接向皇帝负责，成为明朝政治阴影。机构不受常规司法约束，缉捕与审讯可绕过外廷，因而令官员畏惧；其权力随皇帝信任而起伏。后世厂卫并称，成为明代监察与恐怖统治的象征。

title.zh: 马皇后病逝

summary.zh: 明洪武十五年（公元1382年），朱元璋的皇后马皇后病逝。马皇后是朱元璋的结发妻子，以贤德著称。她曾多次劝谏朱元璋宽仁治国，挽救了许多被朱元璋怀疑的官员的性命。马皇后的去世对朱元璋打击很大。

statement.zh: 明洪武15年（公元1382年），朱元璋的皇后马皇后病逝。马皇后是朱元璋的结发妻子，以贤德著称。她曾多次劝谏朱元璋宽仁治国，挽救了许多被朱元璋怀疑的官员的性命。马皇后的去世对朱元璋打击很大。
statement.en:
In 1382 (Hongwu 15), Zhu Yuanzhang's wife, Empress Ma, died. She was his first wife and known for her virtue and kindness, often persuading Zhu to be merciful and saving many officials from his wrath. Her death deeply grieved Zhu Yuanzhang.

For Asia in 1382, “Empress Ma dies” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝定都南京，罢北平布政司

summary.zh: 明洪武十七年（1384年），朱元璋正式定南京（应天府）为京师，同时撤销北平布政司，将其辖区直隶中书省。南京城经过二十年营建，周长约35公里，人口约五十万，是当时世界上最大的城市之一。朱元璋在南京修建了宏伟的皇城和城墙，奠定了明朝近三百年的都城格局。

statement.zh: 明洪武17年（1384年），朱元璋正式定南京（应天府）为京师，同时撤销北平布政司，将其辖区直隶中书省。南京城经过二十年营建，周长约35公里，人口约五十万，是当时世界上最大的城市之一。朱元璋在南京修建了宏伟的皇城和城墙，奠定了明朝近三百年的都城格局。
statement.en:
In 1384 (Hongwu 17), Zhu Yuanzhang formally established Nanjing (Yingtian) as the capital, and the Beiping Administration was dissolved, with its territory directly administered by the Central Secretariat. After twenty years of construction, Nanjing's walls had a perimeter of about 35 km and a population of about 500,000, making it one of the world's largest cities. The imperial palace and walls laid out the capital pattern of the Ming for nearly 300 years.

For Asia in 1384, “Ming makes Nanjing the capital and abolishes the Beiping Administration” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝发生空印案，大规模惩治官员

summary.zh: 明洪武十八年（1385年），朱元璋发现各地官员在向户部上报财政账目时使用预先盖好印章的空白文书（空印）。朱元璋大怒，认为这是官员集体舞弊。他下令严厉追查，数百名官员被处死或流放。这是明初四大案之一。

statement.zh: 明洪武18年（1385年），朱元璋发现各地官员在向户部上报财政账目时使用预先盖好印章的空白文书（空印）。朱元璋大怒，认为这是官员集体舞弊。他下令严厉追查，数百名官员被处死或流放。这是明初四大案之一。
statement.en:
In 1385 (Hongwu 18), Zhu Yuanzhang discovered that local officials, when submitting financial accounts to the Ministry of Revenue, had used pre‑sealed blank documents ('empty seals'). He considered this collective fraud. A strict investigation followed; hundreds of officials were executed or exiled. It was one of the 'Four Major Cases' of the early Ming.

For Asia in 1385, “Ming's Empty Seal case: massive punishment of officials” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝推行里甲制度

summary.zh: 朱元璋下令在全国编订里甲，每110户为一里，设里长；里下分甲，10户为一甲。这种基层管理制度延续至清末。

statement.zh:
朱元璋下令在全国编订里甲，每110户为一里，设里长；里下分甲，10户为一甲。这种基层管理制度延续至清末。里甲以户为单位承担赋役、治安与教化，编制与鱼鳞图册、黄册相连；地方精英借此进入行政。国家能力下沉到乡村。

把「明朝推行里甲制度」放回1386年的明，可以看到政治变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Zhu Yuanzhang ordered the nationwide establishment of lijia: every 110 households formed one li, with a li head; each li was divided into jia of 10 households.

title.zh: 明朝征讨辽东，纳哈出降

summary.zh: 明洪武二十年（1387年），朱元璋派冯胜、傅友德率军20万征讨盘踞辽东的元朝残余势力纳哈出。纳哈出在孤立无援的情况下率部20余万人投降。明朝统一了东北地区，设立了辽东都指挥使司。

statement.zh: 明洪武20年（1387年），朱元璋派冯胜、傅友德率军20万征讨盘踞辽东的元朝残余势力纳哈出。纳哈出在孤立无援的情况下率部20余万人投降。明朝统一了东北地区，设立了辽东都指挥使司。
statement.en:
In 1387 (Hongwu 20), Zhu Yuanzhang sent Feng Sheng and Fu Youde with 200,000 troops against Nahacu, a Yuan remnant leader in Liaodong. Isolated, Nahacu surrendered with over 200,000 men. The Ming unified the northeast and established the Liaodong Regional Military Commission.

For Asia in 1387, “Ming campaigns against Liaodong; Nahacu surrenders” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 乔叟开始创作《坎特伯雷故事集》

summary.zh: 英国诗人杰弗里·乔叟开始写作《坎特伯雷故事集》，以朝圣旅途中各人讲故事的形式，展现中世纪英国社会百态。他用伦敦方言写作，对英语文学影响重大。

statement.zh: 英国诗人杰弗里·乔叟开始写作《坎特伯雷故事集》，以朝圣旅途中各人讲故事的形式，展现中世纪英国社会百态。他用伦敦方言写作，对英语文学影响重大。故事涵盖骑士、教士、商人与工匠，各体裁与语调随人物而变；朝圣的框架把碎片叙事串联。英语的文学地位由此提升。
statement.en: The British poet Geoffrey Chaucer began writing "The Canterbury Tales", which showed the various aspects of British society in the Middle Ages in the form of stories told by everyone during the pilgrimage.

title.zh: 明军捕鱼儿海大捷，北元气数殆尽

summary.zh: 蓝玉率十五万明军在捕鱼儿海（今贝尔湖）突袭北元汗庭，俘获元主脱古思帖木儿次子、妃嫔七千余人，牛羊十五万头。北元皇帝逃走后被部将杀死，蒙古分裂为鞑靼和瓦剌。明朝北方威胁大减。

statement.zh: 蓝玉率十五万明军在捕鱼儿海（今贝尔湖）突袭北元汗庭，俘获元主脱古思帖木儿次子、妃嫔七千余人，牛羊十五万头。北元皇帝逃走后被部将杀死，蒙古分裂为鞑靼和瓦剌。明朝北方威胁大减。
statement.en:
Lan Yu led 150,000 Ming troops in a surprise attack on the Northern Yuan court at Lake Buir (Lake Buyr), capturing the second son of the khan, 7,000 palace women, and 150,000 head of livestock. The Northern Yuan khan fled and was killed by his own men. Mongolia split into Tatar and Oirat confederations. The Ming's northern threat was greatly reduced.

For Asia in 1388, “Ming victory at Lake Buir; Northern Yuan reduced to a rump” is a traceable node of Military change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝设置六部定制

summary.zh: 明洪武二十二年（公元1389年），朱元璋最终确定了六部（吏户礼兵刑工）的定制。六部分别执掌官员任免、财政税收、礼仪祭祀、军事边防、司法刑罚和工程建设。六部尚书直接对皇帝负责。

statement.zh: 明洪武22年（公元1389年），朱元璋最终确定了六部（吏户礼兵刑工）的定制。六部分别执掌官员任免、财政税收、礼仪祭祀、军事边防、司法刑罚和工程建设。六部尚书直接对皇帝负责。
statement.en:
In 1389 (Hongwu 22), Zhu Yuanzhang fixed the structure of the Six Ministries (Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, Works). Each ministry was responsible for its respective domain, and their ministers reported directly to the emperor.

For Asia in 1389, “Ming finalises the Six Ministries structure” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 蓝玉案爆发，功臣宿将几乎杀尽

summary.zh: 朱元璋以谋反罪诛杀凉国公蓝玉，牵连者包括傅友德、冯胜等功臣，族诛者达1.5万人。此后明朝开国功臣除耿炳文外全部被杀。

statement.zh: 朱元璋以谋反罪诛杀凉国公蓝玉，牵连者包括傅友德、冯胜等功臣，族诛者达1.5万人。此后明朝开国功臣除耿炳文外全部被杀。
statement.en:
Zhu Yuanzhang executed the Duke of Liang, Lan Yu, on charges of treason, implicating Fu Youde, Feng Sheng, and other meritorious generals. Some 15,000 people were executed. After this, apart from Geng Bingwen, all the founding generals of the Ming were killed.

For Asia in 1390, “Lan Yu case erupts; most of the founding generals are purged” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 刚果王国建立

summary.zh: 约公元1390年，刚果王国（Kingdom of Kongo）在刚果河下游建立。国王（Manikongo）控制着从大西洋沿岸至内陆的领土。1483年葡萄牙人到达后，刚果国王阿方索一世（约1506-1543）接受基督教和欧洲技术，试图进行现代化改革。刚果与葡萄牙之间的奴隶贸易最终导致了王国的衰亡。该王国是撒哈拉以南非洲最早与欧洲进行密切外交接触的国家之一。

title.zh: 欧洲开始普遍使用黑火药大炮

summary.zh: 百年战争中，英法双方开始大量使用青铜或铁制火炮攻城。加莱、瑟堡等城镇的陷落归功于炮击。火药革命改变战争形态。

statement.zh:
百年战争中，英法双方开始大量使用青铜或铁制火炮攻城。加莱、瑟堡等城镇的陷落归功于炮击。火药革命改变战争形态。火炮以集中火力破坏城墙，攻城从围困转向轰击；铸炮与火药生产需要专门工匠与资源，军事开支与王权集中随之增强。城堡的防御优势被削弱。

把「欧洲开始普遍使用黑火药大炮」放回1390年的欧洲，可以看到科技变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: During the Hundred Years' War, both England and France began using large numbers of bronze or iron cannons for siege warfare.

title.zh: 明朝分封诸王就藩

summary.zh: 明洪武二十四年（公元1391年），朱元璋将成年的儿子们分封到各地为藩王。藩王拥有一定的军事权力和地方影响力（特别是北方边境的"塞王"）。燕王朱棣（后来的永乐帝）被封在北平。

statement.zh: 明洪武24年（公元1391年），朱元璋将成年的儿子们分封到各地为藩王。藩王拥有一定的军事权力和地方影响力（特别是北方边境的"塞王"）。燕王朱棣（后来的永乐帝）被封在北平。
statement.en:
In 1391 (Hongwu 24), Zhu Yuanzhang enfeoffed his adult sons as regional princes. They had certain military powers and influence, especially the 'border princes' in the north. Zhu Di, Prince of Yan (later the Yongle Emperor), was enfeoffed at Beiping.

For Asia in 1391, “Ming assigns princes to their appanages” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 奥斯曼巴耶济德一世继位，加速征服巴尔干

summary.zh: 穆拉德一世战死科索沃，其子巴耶济德一世继位，绰号“闪电”。他快速征服保加利亚、马其顿和色萨利，封锁君士坦丁堡。

statement.zh: 穆拉德一世战死科索沃，其子巴耶济德一世继位，绰号“闪电”。他快速征服保加利亚、马其顿和色萨利，封锁君士坦丁堡。巴耶济德以急行军与围城著称，把巴尔干的诸侯纳为附庸，并调动附庸军队；对君士坦丁堡的长期围困虽未破城，却压缩了拜占庭的空间。奥斯曼由此成为巴尔干的主导力量。
statement.en: Murad I died in the war in Kosovo, and his son Bayezid I succeeded him, nicknamed "Lightning".

title.zh: 李成桂即位，朝鲜王朝建立

summary.zh: 1392年七月，郑道传、赵浚等拥李成桂即位于开京寿昌宫，高丽王朝历四百七十五年而亡。李成桂遣使明朝，以"朝鲜"（取古朝鲜之名）与"和宁"（其父受封之地）二名请择，明太祖朱元璋于次年定为"朝鲜"。1394年迁都汉阳、改称汉城，依《周礼》"左祖右社、面朝后市"之制规划都城，营建景福宫、宗庙与社稷坛。新朝奉性理学为治国纲领，抑佛教、没寺田奴婢，确立两班官僚体制与科

statement.zh: 1392年七月，郑道传、赵浚等拥李成桂即位于开京寿昌宫，高丽王朝历四百七十五年而亡。李成桂遣使明朝，以"朝鲜"（取古朝鲜之名）与"和宁"（其父受封之地）二名请择，明太祖朱元璋于次年定为"朝鲜"。1394年迁都汉阳、改称汉城，依《周礼》"左祖右社、面朝后市"之制规划都城，营建景福宫、宗庙与社稷坛。新朝奉性理学为治国纲领，抑佛教、没寺田奴婢，确立两班官僚体制与科举取士；郑道传所撰《朝鲜经国典》奠定法制基础，其"宰相政治"主张与李芳远的王权集中路线冲突，终致他在1398年"王子之乱"中被杀。朝鲜王朝历二十七王、五百一十九年，是朝鲜半岛历时最长的王朝。
statement.en:
In the seventh month of 1392 Jeong Do-jeon, Jo Jun and their allies raised Yi Seong-gye to the throne at Kaegyong, ending the Goryeo dynasty after 475 years. Yi sent envoys to the Ming offering two names for the realm—Joseon, after the ancient kingdom, and Hwaryeong, his father's fief—and the Hongwu Emperor chose Joseon the following year. In 1394 the capital moved to Hanyang, renamed Hanseong, laid out on the classical plan with the royal ancestral shrine to the left and the altars of soil and grain to the right, around the new Gyeongbok Palace. The dynasty governed by Neo-Confucian principles, curbing Buddhism, confiscating temple lands and slaves, and building a yangban bureaucracy recruited by examination. Jeong Do-jeon's Administrative Code of Joseon laid its legal foundation, but his vision of rule by ministers clashed with Yi Bang-won's drive for royal autocracy and cost him his life in the princes' strife of 1398. Joseon lasted 519 years under 27 kings, the longest dynasty in Korean history.

For Asia in 1392, “Yi Seong-gye takes the throne; the Joseon dynasty is founded” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝颁行《洪武礼制》

summary.zh: 明洪武二十六年（1393年），朱元璋命李善长、刘基等儒臣编纂的《洪武礼制》正式颁行。该书系统规定了皇室、官员和平民的服饰、婚丧、祭祀、朝会等礼仪制度。朱元璋通过礼制严格区分社会等级秩序，试图建立一套覆盖从朝廷到民间的完整礼仪体系，强化皇权和儒家伦理。

statement.zh: 明洪武26年（1393年），朱元璋命李善长、刘基等儒臣编纂的《洪武礼制》正式颁行。该书系统规定了皇室、官员和平民的服饰、婚丧、祭祀、朝会等礼仪制度。朱元璋通过礼制严格区分社会等级秩序，试图建立一套覆盖从朝廷到民间的完整礼仪体系，强化皇权和儒家伦理。
statement.en:
In 1393 (Hongwu 26), the Hongwu Ritual Regulations, compiled by Li Shanchang, Liu Ji, and other Confucian scholars, were formally issued. The work prescribed clothing, marriage, funerary rites, sacrifices, and court ceremonies for the imperial family, officials, and commoners. Through these regulations, Zhu Yuanzhang sought to reinforce social hierarchy and Confucian ethics, creating a comprehensive ritual system from court to countryside.

For Asia in 1393, “Ming issues the Hongwu Ritual Regulations” is a traceable node of Culture change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明太祖诏定国号"朝鲜"

summary.zh: 李成桂代高丽自立后，遣使赴南京奏请更定国号，以"朝鲜"（取箕子朝鲜之古名）与"和宁"（其父李子春受封之地）二名请择。明太祖朱元璋以"东夷之号，惟朝鲜之称美，且其来远矣，可以本其名而祖之"，于洪武二十六年二月诏定国号为朝鲜。然明廷对其篡立终存芥蒂，仅许李成桂"权知朝鲜国事"而不予正式册封，亦不颁赐金印诰命；直至1401年，明廷才正式册封太宗李芳远为朝鲜国王。此

statement.en: After supplanting Goryeo, Yi Seong-gye sent envoys to Nanjing asking the Ming court to settle a new name for the state, offering two candidates: "Joseon", the ancient name associated with Gija, and "Hwaryeong", the district where his father Yi Ja-chun had held office.

en: The Ming nonetheless distrusted a usurper: Yi Seong-gye was allowed only to "provisionally administer the affairs of Joseon", receiving neither formal investiture nor the gold seal and patent, and it was not until 1401 that the court formally invested his son Taejong as King of Joseon.

statement.en: For the next 500 years Joseon used the Ming and then Qing calendars and made "serving the great" the foundation of its statecraft, forming the closest bond in the East Asian tributary order.

Yi Seong-Gye, who established the capital at Hanyang (present-day Seoul), the kingdom was named Joseon for the state of the same name that had dominated the Korean peninsula in ancient times.

note.zh: 来源记1392年李成桂建立朝鲜王朝、以古朝鲜之名“Joseon”为国号、定都汉阳；事件标1393年并称明太祖朱元璋诏定国号、引“东夷之号惟朝鲜之称美”、只许“权知朝鲜国事”、1401年才册封太宗，来源未在同段支持1393年诏书、洪武引语与册封细节，claim 用1392年并只写建国、国号与都城。
note.en: The source dates the Joseon dynasty's founding to 1392, says Yi Seong-Gye established the capital at Hanyang, and that the kingdom was named Joseon after the ancient state; the event is dated 1393 and adds the Hongwu emperor's decree, his quotation that Joseon was the finest of the eastern names, the provisional “administer the affairs of Joseon” status, and the 1401 investiture of Taejong, none of which is supported in the same passage, so the claim uses 1392 and keeps only the founding, name, and capital.

title.zh: 明朝严禁宦官干政，立铁碑

summary.zh: 明洪武二十七年（1394年），朱元璋鉴于历代宦官之祸，在宫门竖立铁碑，镌刻"内臣不得干预政事，违者斩"的禁令。朱元璋规定宦官不得识字、不得兼任外朝官职、不得与官员私下交往。然而明朝中后期（特别是永乐以后），皇帝出于对文官集团的不信任，逐渐重用宦官。铁碑的禁令最终形同虚设。

statement.zh: 明洪武27年（1394年），朱元璋鉴于历代宦官之祸，在宫门竖立铁碑，镌刻"内臣不得干预政事，违者斩"的禁令。朱元璋规定宦官不得识字、不得兼任外朝官职、不得与官员私下交往。然而明朝中后期（特别是永乐以后），皇帝出于对文官集团的不信任，逐渐重用宦官。铁碑的禁令最终形同虚设。
statement.en:
In 1394 (Hongwu 27), recalling the scourge of eunuchs in previous dynasties, Zhu Yuanzhang erected an iron tablet at the palace gate inscribed: 'Eunuchs shall not interfere in government; violators will be beheaded.' He ruled that eunuchs should not learn to read, not hold external offices, and not have private dealings with officials. Nevertheless, in the mid‑to‑late Ming (especially after Yongle), distrust of the scholar‑official class led emperors to rely on eunuchs. The iron prohibition became a dead letter.

For Asia in 1394, “Ming strictly forbids eunuch interference, sets up an iron tablet” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 奥斯曼长围君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 巴耶济德一世封锁都城达八年，切断粮道，城内饥馑严重，直至帖木儿在安卡拉击溃奥斯曼才暂解危局。

statement.zh:
巴耶济德一世封锁都城达八年，切断粮道，城内饥馑严重，直至帖木儿在安卡拉击溃奥斯曼才暂解危局。封锁以陆上围困与海峡控制相结合，拜占庭只能依靠海运与零星补给维持；城内人口因饥荒与逃亡减少。安卡拉之战后，奥斯曼进入内争，围攻随之解除。

把「奥斯曼长围君士坦丁堡」放回1394年的拜占庭帝国，可以看到军事变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Bayezid I blocked the capital for eight years, cutting off food routes and causing severe famine in the city.

title.zh: 朝鲜迁都汉城（汉阳）

summary.zh: 明洪武二十七年（1394年），朝鲜太祖李成桂正式将都城从开京迁至汉阳（今首尔）。新都按照风水原则规划，修建了景福宫、宗庙和社稷坛等重要建筑。汉城此后成为朝鲜王朝五百余年的首都。

statement.zh: 明洪武27年（1394年），朝鲜太祖李成桂正式将都城从开京迁至汉阳（今首尔）。新都按照风水原则规划，修建了景福宫、宗庙和社稷坛等重要建筑。汉城此后成为朝鲜王朝五百余年的首都。
statement.en:
In 1394 (Hongwu 27), King Taejo of Joseon (Yi Seong‑gye) moved the capital from Kaegyong (Kaesong) to Hanyang (present‑day Seoul). The new capital was laid out according to geomancy (feng shui) principles, with Gyeongbokgung Palace, the Royal Ancestral Shrine, and the Altars of Land and Grain. Seoul remained the capital of Joseon for over 500 years.

For Asia in 1394, “Joseon moves capital to Hanyang (Seoul)” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

Seoul remained the capital of Joseon for over 500 years.

title.zh: 明朝规定皇室与功臣通婚条例

summary.zh: 明洪武二十八年（公元1395年），朱元璋规定了皇室与功臣之间通婚的条例。他强调皇室公主和郡主应嫁给功臣子弟，以加强皇室与功臣集团的联系。同时禁止外戚干政。

statement.zh: 明洪武28年（公元1395年），朱元璋规定了皇室与功臣之间通婚的条例。他强调皇室公主和郡主应嫁给功臣子弟，以加强皇室与功臣集团的联系。同时禁止外戚干政。
statement.en:
In 1395 (Hongwu 28), Zhu Yuanzhang laid down rules for marriage between the imperial family and the families of meritorious officials. He stressed that princesses should marry the sons of meritorious officials to strengthen ties, while also forbidding the influence of consort families.

For Asia in 1395, “Ming issues regulations for royal‑meritocratic intermarriage” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 明朝修《诸司职掌》，规范官制

summary.zh: 明洪武二十九年（1396年），朱元璋下令编纂《诸司职掌》，详细规定了中央和地方各机构的职权范围和办事程序。这是明代官制的重要文献，为后世明朝行政制度提供了规范蓝本。

statement.zh: 明洪武29年（1396年），朱元璋下令编纂《诸司职掌》，详细规定了中央和地方各机构的职权范围和办事程序。这是明代官制的重要文献，为后世明朝行政制度提供了规范蓝本。
statement.en:
In 1396 (Hongwu 29), Zhu Yuanzhang ordered the compilation of the 'Duties of the Various Offices', which detailed the functions and procedures of central and local agencies. This was an important Ming administrative document, providing a standard model for later officials.

For Asia in 1396, “Ming compiles the 'Duties of the Various Offices', standardising bureaucracy” is a traceable node of Politics change whose significance is best read through later events.

title.zh: 尼科波利斯：十字军被巴耶济德一世击溃

summary.zh: 1396年9月25日，巴耶济德一世在尼科波利斯（今保加利亚）击败一支由匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德统率的国际十字军。教皇博尼法斯九世在1394年发出号召，法国、勃艮第、匈牙利、波希米亚、克罗地亚、德国与医院骑士团都派兵；十字军约12,000–15,000人，奥斯曼军队约25,000人，法军骑士抢先冲锋导致阵线脱节。

statement.zh: 1396年9月25日，巴耶济德一世在尼科波利斯（今保加利亚）击败一支由匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德名义统率的十字军。教皇博尼法斯九世在1394年发出号召，法国、勃艮第、匈牙利、波希米亚、克罗地亚、德国与医院骑士团都派出了队伍。
statement.en: On September 25, 1396, Bayezid I defeated an international crusade nominally led by Sigismund of Hungary at Nicopolis in present-day Bulgaria. Pope Boniface IX called for the crusade in 1394, and France, Burgundy, Hungary, Bohemia, Croatia, Germany and the Knights Hospitaller sent contingents.

sources.locator: Britannica, Battle of Nicopolis, opening paragraphs
sources.excerpt: Battle of Nicopolis, a catastrophic military defeat for Christian knights at the hands of the Ottoman Turks on September 25, 1396. It brought an end to massive international efforts to halt Turkish expansion into the Balkans and central Europe. This development led Pope Boniface IX in 1394 to call for a crusade against the rising power of the Muslim Ottoman Turks in southeast Europe. In response to the pope's call, nobles from across Christian Europe eventually signed up for the venture, including large contingents from France, Burgundy, Hungary, Bohemia, Croatia, and Germany and from the Knights Hospitaller. Led by Sigismund, King of Hungary, they embarked on the long journey to the Danubian fortress of Nicopolis in modern-day Bulgaria.

zh: 1396年9月25日，巴耶济德一世在尼科波利斯（今保加利亚）击败一支由匈牙利国王西吉斯蒙德名义统率的十字军。教皇博尼法斯九世在1394年发出号召，法国、勃艮第、匈牙利、波希米亚、克罗地亚、德国与医院骑士团都派出了队伍。
en: On September 25, 1396, Bayezid I defeated an international crusade nominally led by Sigismund of Hungary at Nicopolis in present-day Bulgaria. Pope Boniface IX called for the crusade in 1394, and France, Burgundy, Hungary, Bohemia, Croatia, Germany and the Knights Hospitaller sent contingents.

note.zh: 不写“勃艮第公爵组织”“援助君士坦丁堡”等旧稿简化。
note.en: Rejects the old simplifications of a Burgundian-organized crusade to relieve Constantinople.

statement.zh: 十字军约有12,000–15,000人，奥斯曼军队约25,000人。法国骑士抢先冲锋，与匈牙利部队脱节；巴耶济德投入预备队和约5,000名塞尔维亚士兵反击，完成包围。
statement.en: The crusaders numbered about 12,000–15,000 against some 25,000 Ottoman troops. The French knights charged first and separated themselves from the Hungarian support; Bayezid committed his reserves and about 5,000 Serbian soldiers in a flanking counterattack that completed the encirclement.

sources.locator: Britannica, Battle of Nicopolis, tactical narrative and losses
sources.excerpt: The charge was initially successful, but Bayezid responded with his reserves, as well as a force of some 5,000 Serbian soldiers whose flanking attack was critical to the Ottomans' success. In their rush to secure the glory of victory for themselves, the French knights had become separated from their Hungarian support, and as Bayezid counterattacked they were destroyed. Losses: Ottoman, considerable of 25,000; Crusader, most dead or captured of 12,000–15,000.

zh: 十字军约有12,000–15,000人，奥斯曼军队约25,000人。法国骑士抢先冲锋，与匈牙利部队脱节；巴耶济德投入预备队和约5,000名塞尔维亚士兵反击，完成包围。
en: The crusaders numbered about 12,000–15,000 against some 25,000 Ottoman troops. The French knights charged first and separated themselves from the Hungarian support; Bayezid committed his reserves and about 5,000 Serbian soldiers in a flanking counterattack that completed the encirclement.

note.zh: 损失数字按来源写，不夸大为“全军覆没”。
note.en: Losses follow the source and are not inflated to total annihilation.

statement.zh: 西吉斯蒙德是少数逃出的人之一。巴耶济德随后处决了大部分战俘；这场胜利结束了大规模国际救援巴尔干的努力。
statement.en: Sigismund was among the few who escaped. Bayezid then had most of the prisoners executed; the victory ended a massive international effort to halt Ottoman expansion in the Balkans.

sources.locator: Britannica, Battle of Nicopolis, final paragraph
sources.excerpt: Sigismund was among the few to escape. After the battle Bayezid had most of his prisoners executed. It brought an end to massive international efforts to halt Turkish expansion into the Balkans and central Europe.

zh: 西吉斯蒙德是少数逃出的人之一。巴耶济德随后处决了大部分战俘；这场胜利结束了大规模国际救援巴尔干的努力。
en: Sigismund was among the few who escaped. Bayezid then had most of the prisoners executed; the victory ended a massive international effort to halt Ottoman expansion in the Balkans.

note.zh: “让欧洲恐惧”是对来源“Europe was terrorized”的转述。
note.en: 'Spread fear across Europe' paraphrases the source's 'Europe was terrorized'.

statement.zh: 尼科波利斯的胜利没有让巴耶济德一世变成不可战胜的霸主。1402年，他在安卡拉被帖木儿击败，奥斯曼帝国进入空位期；欧洲对尼科波利斯的记忆，与帝国这次短暂崩塌同时存在。
statement.en: Nicopolis did not make Bayezid I invincible. In 1402 Timur defeated him at Ankara, and the Ottoman Empire entered an interregnum; Europe's memory of Nicopolis coexisted with this temporary collapse of the empire.

sources.locator: Britannica, Ottoman Empire, section 'Restoration of the Ottoman Empire, 1402–81', opening paragraph
sources.excerpt: Bayezid I, 'the Thunderbolt,' victor at the Battle of Nicopolis in 1396, was defeated by the Turkic ruler Timur at the Battle of Ankara on July 20, 1402. Bayezid's humiliating loss came close to destroying the Ottoman Empire.

zh: 尼科波利斯的胜利没有让巴耶济德一世变成不可战胜的霸主。1402年，他在安卡拉被帖木儿击败，奥斯曼帝国进入空位期；欧洲对尼科波利斯的记忆，与帝国这次短暂崩塌同时存在。
en: Nicopolis did not make Bayezid I invincible. In 1402 Timur defeated him at Ankara, and the Ottoman Empire entered an interregnum; Europe's memory of Nicopolis coexisted with this temporary collapse of the empire.

note.zh: 安卡拉只作为反高潮出现，不展开战役细节。
note.en: Ankara appears as a counter-climax, without tactical detail.

reasons.zh: 断言核验仍为机器摘录，待人工复核，不能升级
reasons.en: Claim verification is machine-extracted and cannot be promoted before human review

title.zh: 京都建金阁寺

summary.zh: 室町幕府第三代将军足利义满在京都北山建舍利殿，外覆金箔、临镜湖池，是北山文化的象征，今称金阁寺（鹿苑寺）。

statement.zh:
室町幕府第三代将军足利义满在京都北山建舍利殿，外覆金箔、临镜湖池，是北山文化的象征，今称金阁寺（鹿苑寺）。建筑以多层楼阁与池岸对景组织景观，金箔在晴日映水成双；庭园与禅寺制度相连，将军的宗教赞助与政治声望交织。

把「京都建金阁寺」放回1397年的日本，可以看到建筑变化的一个具体切面。
statement.en: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, the third generation shogun of the Muromachi shogunate, built a relic hall in Kitayama, Kyoto, covered with gold foil and facing a mirror lake.

title.zh: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，皇太孙朱允炆即位

summary.zh: 朱元璋在南京病逝，享年70岁。遗诏皇太孙朱允炆即位，年号建文。朱允炆随即开始削藩，导致燕王朱棣起兵。

statement.zh:
朱元璋在南京病逝，享年70岁。遗诏皇太孙朱允炆即位，年号建文。朱允炆随即开始削藩，导致燕王朱棣起兵。洪武以来的强干弱枝政策留下诸王拥兵的局面，建文帝以削藩收权，却激化了宗室与中央的矛盾；靖难之役由此爆发。

title.zh: 靖难之役爆发，朱棣起兵反建文帝

title.zh: 曼努埃尔二世西行求援

summary.zh: 皇帝亲赴威尼斯、巴黎与伦敦游说，成为唯一到访英格兰的东罗马君主，然所获援助微乎其微。

statement.zh: 皇帝亲赴威尼斯、巴黎与伦敦游说，成为唯一到访英格兰的东罗马君主，然所获援助微乎其微。此行意在请求西欧君主出兵救援，皇帝以随行学者与外交礼仪展示帝国的文化声望，换来的多为口头同情与零星资助。西行暴露了拜占庭在军事与财政上的孤立，也加深了东西方之间的认知落差。
statement.en: The emperor personally went to Venice, Paris and London to lobby, becoming the only Eastern Roman monarch to visit England, but he received little help.

title.zh: 靖难之役白沟河大战，朱棣反败为胜

summary.zh: 李景隆率60万大军与朱棣10万人在白沟河激战。朱棣几乎被俘，但突降狂风折断李景隆帅旗，南军溃败。此战李景隆全线崩溃，朱棣转守为攻。

title.zh: 法国作家克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑创作《妇女城》

summary.zh: 法国女权主义先驱克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑撰写《妇女城》，反击男性对女性的污蔑，主张女性教育和美德。她是欧洲第一位靠写作谋生的女性。

statement.zh: 法国女权主义先驱克里斯蒂娜·德·皮桑撰写《妇女城》，反击男性对女性的污蔑，主张女性教育和美德。她是欧洲第一位靠写作谋生的女性。书中以寓意城堡收容历代贤女，借理性、正直与正义三位圣女之口答辩；她亦批评《玫瑰传奇》的贬女之笔，为女性才能在公共讨论中争得位置。
statement.en: French feminist pioneer Christine de Pisan wrote "City of Women" to counter men's slander of women and advocate female education and virtue.

title.zh: 乔叟逝世，葬于威斯敏斯特教堂诗人角

summary.zh: 英国诗歌之父杰弗里·乔叟去世，成为首位安葬在威斯敏斯特教堂诗人角的诗人。《坎特伯雷故事集》开创了英语文学传统。

statement.zh:

title.zh: 刚果王国兴起

summary.zh: 刚果王国约14世纪末兴起于刚果河下游，都城姆班扎刚果。国王（马尼刚果）之下设省督与地方酋长，以恩齐姆布贝壳为货币，铜与棕榈布贸易发达。1483年葡萄牙人到达后，国王恩津加·恩库武受洗改称若昂一世，成为最早皈依基督教的非洲王国之一。

title.zh: 马六甲苏丹国

summary.zh: 约1400年，巨港王子拜里米苏拉出走马来半岛，在马六甲河口建城立国。马六甲扼守海峡最窄处，坐收季风转运之利，明朝郑和船队多次驻泊于此并助其抗暹罗。其统治者其后皈依伊斯兰教，使马六甲成为东南亚伊斯兰传播的中心，1511年为葡萄牙攻陷。

title.zh: 罗贯中撰《三国演义》

summary.zh: 罗贯中以陈寿《三国志》、裴松之注及宋元话本、杂剧为本，编成长篇章回小说《三国演义》，起自黄巾之乱、止于西晋统一，凡一百二十回。全书“七实三虚”，塑造诸葛亮、关羽、曹操等形象深入人心，明嘉靖本为现存最早刊本，被列为中国四大名著之一。

statement.zh: 罗贯中以陈寿《三国志》、裴松之注及宋元话本、杂剧为本，编成长篇章回小说《三国演义》，起自黄巾之乱、止于西晋统一，凡一百二十回。
statement.en: Drawing on Chen Shou's Records of the Three Kingdoms with Pei Songzhi's commentary, together with Song and Yuan storytellers' scripts and plays, Luo Guanzhong composed the chaptered novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms in 120 chapters, running from the Yellow Turban rebellion to the reunification under the Western Jin.

title.zh: 欧洲古腾堡尚未发明印刷机，但雕版印刷已从东方传入

summary.zh: 公元1400年前后，欧洲开始使用木版雕版印刷技术制作扑克牌、圣像和宗教书籍的单页插图。雕版印刷术由马可·波罗等旅行者从中国经丝绸之路传入欧洲。欧洲工匠在法国、意大利和德意志地区建立了雕版印刷作坊，为约五十年后古腾堡发明金属活字印刷术积累了技术经验。雕版印刷和活字印刷的结合引发了欧洲信息革命和宗教改革。

公元1400年前后，欧洲开始使用木版雕版印刷技术制作扑克牌、圣像和宗教书籍的单页插图。雕版印刷术由马可·波罗等旅行者从中国经丝绸之路传入欧洲。欧洲工匠在法国、意大利和德意志地区建立了雕版印刷作坊，为约五十年后古腾堡发明金属活字印刷术积累了技术经验。雕版印刷和活字印刷的结合引发了欧洲信息革命和宗教改革。

1400年的欧洲，「欧洲古腾堡尚未发明印刷机，但雕版印刷已从东方传入」属于科技领域。
statement.en: Workshops were established in France, Italy, and Germany, accumulating technical experience that would lead to Gutenberg's movable type half a century later.
